 海外玩家注意： 由于我们的游戏服务器位于中国大陆，海外玩家可能会遇到网络不稳定和卡顿的情况。对此，我们深表歉意，并感谢您的理解。

 未来随着我们经济基础的增强，我们将积极考虑开通国际服，以改善海外玩家的网络体验。

store.name: The Defiant
store.short: Heroic stories from the Chinese battlefields of World War II will be brought to life in the form of a FPS game.
store.about:
In those dark years, we had long grown accustomed to separation and death.
 The aggressors trampled our nation underfoot, leaving every inch of land engulfed in flames of war.
 We are the indomitable Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, operating in the snowy forests of Northeast China.
 We are the unyielding underground radio operators during the desperate Isolated Island period in Shanghai.
 We are the formidable Canal Detachment, a spearhead seeking swift justice.
 We are the Great Wall built with flesh and blood, standing majestically atop the Taihang Mountains of North China.
 Take up arms! We are The Defiant!
 Scene: Back to Moments of Crisis in History 
 The land we set foot upon is soaked with the blood of heroes.
 From the bleak, snowy forests of Northeast China, to the heavily fortified streets and alleys of occupied towns, and to the treacherous villages behind enemy lines... Here, you will be immersed in the somber, tragic and volatile atmosphere of China's War of Resistance.

 Level: An Immersive Experience 
 Here, every tree, every blade of grass, every brick and stone bears silent witness to that turbulent and heroic era.

 Firearm: Every weapon is an echo of history. 
 What you hold is not merely a weapon, but a historical relic carrying the memories of battles fought nearly a century ago.
 The game features dozens of firearms, including a wide range of rifles, submachine guns, pistols and machine guns. There are the classic Hanyang 88 rifle, the legendary Mauser C96 and SIG Bergmann Model 1920, along with many other weapons that emerged throughout modern...

store.name: Welcome to Elderfield
store.short: Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more... There's lots to do in Elderfield!
store.about:
Welcome to Elderfield is a cozy horror RPG where the abnormal is normal, the townsfolk are odd, the eldritch beings watch over you and the local news reports seem stranger by the day. 

 Everything in Elderfield is unsettling, from the haunting, horror manga-inspired, hand-drawn visuals to the dark, lofi soundscapes composed by Dated. Despite the strange creatures lurking just outside your home, those who wander into Elderfield rarely find a reason… or option, to leave. 

 Customize your home and character, unravel daily mysteries, befriend the odd townsfolk (or even marry one!), go fishing, spend your afternoons mining and forage through the surrounding wilds… There's lots to do in Elderfield! 

 Cultivate your land, harvest your crops, and stop the growth of unruly tentacles. Manage a variety of strange, otherworldly livestock, grow useful crops like corn, pumpkins, teeth or eyeballs and hope that beings from the woods don’t wander onto your farm .

 Choose your difficulty, how much suffering can you endure? For players seeking a peaceful life of harvest and discovery, cozy difficulty offers a more laid-back experience . For those who crave a challenge, the Old Gods are waiting . 
 Elderfield features a deep, turn-based combat system where you must utilize gathered resources, strategic buffs and diverse equipment to survive encounters with ancient, Lovecraftian horrors.
 Die, learn, farm, and forage… Then die again. 

 Full RPG life sim with relationships, customization, fishing and more 

 Hand drawn horror manga inspired artwork 

 Dark lofi soundtrack by Dated 

...

store.name: My Time at Evershine
store.short: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!
store.about:
The third game of the My Time series. Evershine is a 3D open world Simulation RPG that takes place in a wholesome post-apocalyptic world 330 years after the Day of Calamity destroyed civilization. After surviving the nuclear winter for hundreds of years underground, people are finally picking up the piece again…

 The story takes place 3 years after the events of My Time at Sandrock and My Time at Portia. The Duvos Empire has taken over the Orzu Ruins which the Principality of Ethea also claims as their own, leading to a tense situation just north of the Alliance of Free Cities border in the Northern Eufaula region. The Alliance initiated the North Development Plan to move more settlers into the region in an effort to establish a new City State for a better defensive posture. It is calling on anyone interested in new opportunities to move to the region... 

 Develop romantic relationships with ten core, charming NPCs, including four chosen by backers' votes, and experience heart-pounding moments in every interaction. Beyond romance, you’ll meet over twenty unique NPCs, each with their own personality, ready to be part of your settlement. As you invite them in, you’ll forge deep, lasting bonds that grow stronger over time. 

 You’ll be playing as the Governor of the Evershine Settlement, recruited into the North Development Plan by the project’s Director, Mr. Gaudi. Your job will be to build up the infrastructure (either by prefabs or DIY), recruit the right settlers, tame the wilds, and build up your settlement into a strong presence next to the border. Along the way, you...

store.name: County of Fortune
store.short: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.
store.about:
Build an entire medieval county, not just one town. You place whole settlements across the county and lay each one out on a medieval grid. Each one grows, specializes, and knits into a living region where rivers and resources decide what thrives.

As the county matures, a second game begins. Named mayors run each settlement. Rival noble houses weave politics across the region. And migrating cultures bless some villages, while complicating others. 

Will you raise one prosperous heartland, or a patchwork of proud rival houses?

 You are a lokator – a medieval colonizer and noble steward – given a blank stretch of kingdom to turn into a living county.
 Pick the site for every settlement and set its direction – streets and grid fill in as it grows.

 Guide every village as it grows from a tiny hamlet into a sprawling town, and eventually a city

 Watch procedurally generated buildings fill out your settlements, street by street

 Link your holdings into a single seamless region, not a medley of disconnected outposts

 The scale is the point. You are not zooming into a single town – you are zooming out to see a whole county come to life.

 No two patches of ground play the same way.
 Resource deposits, biomes, and terrain profiles decide what each plot is good for

 Navigable rivers turn geography into logistics – place wisely and trade flows

 Climate, soil, and elevation shape which crops, industries, and products thrive

 Trade routes between settlements follow real terrain – rivers, passes, and roads, not straight lines

 Where you build is as important as what you build....

store.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
store.short: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.
store.about:
Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. 

 If you loved the first game, buckle up, you’re in for a hole lot more. New courses, new chaos, and enough ridiculous moments to make you question your friendship choices (in the best possible way).

 And if you’ve never played Golf With Your Friends before? Friend. Where have you been? Hiding in a bunker? It’s fine — you can jump straight in with everyone else soon. Very soon.

 Twelve. Players. Twelve. 
 More late nights. More arguments. More moments where someone sinks a hole-in-one by pure accident and won’t stop talking about it for the rest of the round. Whether you’re playing locally or cross platform, everyone’s invited.

 Introducing Chaos Mode, where the courses fight back! 
 Putt your way through remixed courses, where players who can adapt on the fly and embrace the chaos, come out on top. No two playthroughs are the same in this brand-new experience.

 Build the course of your (or someone else’s) nightmares 
 The revamped level editor (course creator) is now available on all platforms! Giving you more tools, more options, and more power to create courses that your friends will either applaud or never forgive you for. Build it, share it and take zero responsibility for what happens next.

 Golf With Your Friends 2. More modes, more mayhem, more reasons to question your life choices.
 Wishlist now. Fall is closer than it looks.

store.name: Erosion
store.short: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?
store.about:
Your daughter's been kidnapped by a warlord and dragged into the mysterious living Pillar that warps time itself. You're gonna get her back. The catch? When you die, the world jumps forward a decade, aging your daughter and changing the world around you.

 Die in a dungeon? Wake up ten years later. That peaceful farm is now a cultist compound worshipping the Great Ol' Rooster. That store owner you helped? They've built an empire. Your choices permeate across decades, transforming factions, townsfolk, and entire regions. Once you’ve mastered full timeline control, you can rewrite every possible future.

 Explore a massive wasteland overworld where you can join a cult, steal a slick new ride, and gamble your hard-earned Cheddar away at the Al Cashino. Go sand fishing for buried creatures, hunt bounties, try your luck in duels, or just race trucks through the salt flats. Complete quests to unlock permanent upgrades and reshape the future.

 Collect dozens of weapons from ritual bows that draw their strength from your blood, to homing smart guns, to the legendary Ebony Rooster that shoots bouncy eggs. Experiment with 100+ skills and modifiers to create absurd synergies. Command an army of cats. Deploy orbital turrets. Clone yourself. The build possibilities are endless.

 Destructible voxel environments mean cover is temporary and collateral damage is guaranteed. Blow up walls, turn locations into rubble, and flip the poker table! Physics-driven destruction meets bullet-hell combat for that sweet, sweet emergent mayhem.

store.name: Sandcastle
store.short: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment.
store.about:
Sandcastle is the ultimate sandbox game. Unlock a variety of tools to gather wet sand, shape towering walls, carve intricate battlements, and engineer elaborate moats designed to withstand or divert the encroaching waves.

 No rush, just relax 
 There are no ticking clocks. Only the slow rhythm of the tide and the warm glow of the sun. Discover secret treasures washed ashore or buried deep into the sand, each adding a touch of personality to your sandy masterpiece.

 Physics simulation 
 Beneath the whimsy lies a unique water and sand physics simulation that brings your creations to life. Sand compacts, crumbles, and holds its shape depending on moisture and pressure, while waves flow, pool, and gently erode your walls just as they would in reality. Carve too thin and a tower may slump; reinforce with damp sand and it will stand proud against the tide. The result is a tactile, authentic sand castle crafting experience that feels just like building one on a real beach: sun-warmed, hands-on, and wonderfully satisfying.

 Beach customization 
 Collect starfishes to unlock customization options: Sand type, beach layout, size... Give your beach its own character and charm. Peaceful atolls ringed by turquoise waters, quiet lagoons with gentle shallows, sweeping sand barriers shaped by the breeze, and winding deltas where little streams meet the sea. Every shoreline offers a fresh canvas, inviting you to build, decorate, and relax in a new seaside setting.

 Features 
 Beaches with unique water and sand physic simulation

 Many tools to craft your castle with precision

 10...

store.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
store.short: Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him. Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.
store.about:
As the KINGDOM HEARTS series approaches its 25th anniversary, a new adventure begins.

 Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return from this modern metropolis to his own world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld in hopes of finding a clue to his whereabouts.

 The dynamic, fast-paced battle system allows you to effortlessly combine attacks and magic, as well as build combos with a brand-new battle feature.

 Change the Keyblade Sora wields to unleash unique attacks, matching the flow of battle to your own strategies and play style.

store.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
store.short: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.
store.about:
"Pioneer Your Path in Auroria, the Land of Opportunity" 

 ▶A World of Story and Adventure 

It is the Age of Pioneers. Auroria, a legend long forgotten, has been rediscovered. Now, many hopeful pioneers are headed to this distant land to make a name for themselves. As an experienced explorer, you will be taking your first steps into Auroria as a member of an established trading company. As you embark on this new adventure, you will explore ancient ruins, investigate a catastrophic airship crash, and become embroiled in the web of intrigue surrounding the mysterious and tragic event. Along the way you will meet many characters shrouded in mystery, each with their own secrets and goals. Who will help you and who will stand against you as you experience the unfolding story of Auroria in ArcheAge Chronicles?

 ▶Action-Packed Combat 

Experience intense battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. ArcheAge Chronicles transcends traditional MMORPG mechanics with its fluid, sophisticated action combat. Choose from a variety of weapons and skills to create a unique build and overcome powerful foes. Explore a wide range of combat styles including close-quarters melee, deadly ranged attacks, and powerful magic. Engage dynamically as you jump, fall, roll, dash, block, and parry. No matter your preferred playstyle, ArcheAge Chronicles delivers a high-quality combat experience.

 ▶Unique Features and Innovations 

Engage in rich life skills content such as hunting, gathering, housing, farming, and crafting. Learn new recipes, trade with other players, and build a pioneer...

store.name: Melvor Idle 2
store.short: Embark on a brand-new RuneScape idle adventure with Melvor Idle 2. Master iconic RuneScape Skills, face powerful Combat challenges, or uncover the history of the world via Quests, all while enjoying zen-like progression.
store.about:
Embark on a brand new adventure in Melvor Idle 2! 
 Melvor Idle 2  expands upon the beloved foundations of its predecessor and the wider world, to bring a deeper, richer, and more refined idle gaming experience. This  single-player  adventure lets you explore an ever-growing world of skills, combat, and strategy at your own pace.
 Whether you're a veteran of idle games, a fan of the original Melvor or a maxxed out RuneScape completionist,  Melvor Idle 2  offers a fresh adventure that balances depth with accessibility. It's the ultimate idle RPG for both busy adventurers and those ready to immerse themselves in a constantly evolving world

 Master Melvor’s many unique skills with just a click or a tap. Melvor Idle 2 is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly RuneScape feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing your skills has never been more zen! If you are looking for a deep but accessible adventure that easily fits around a busy lifestyle, then Melvor Idle 2 is an idle experience unlike any other.
 Every skill in this game serves a purpose, interacting with the others in interesting ways. This means all the hard work you put into one skill will in turn benefit others. What strategy will you conjure to achieve maximum skillage?
 It doesn’t just end with Woodcutting, Smithing, Cooking and Farming either – take your finely honed tapping abilities into battle and face off against monsters using your Melee, Ranged and Magic skills. Conquering brutal dungeons and toppling boisterous bosses has never been quite like this before…
 In addition to the skills...

store.name: Planet Zoo 2
store.short: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.
store.about:
Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. 

 Discover a diverse roster of animal species, each with their own needs & behaviours. New faces join familiar favourites like the Lion and Western Chimpanzee to create iconic zoo rosters in jaw-dropping detail. 

 Construct beautiful habitats for your animals to thrive in as they interact with the world around them in authentic ways. From authentic herding behaviours to grazing on the vegetation you provide for them. Experience a generational leap of animal detail and immersion with incredible natural movements and expressive emotions that bring each animal to life like never before. 

 Prepare your diving suit! Fully aquatic species make a splash in their stunning debut! Build custom spectacular freshwater or saltwater aquariums to home an exciting line-up of delightful swimming animals. A new world beneath the water awaits, filled with colourful shoals of fish, Blacktip Reef Sharks, Hawksbill Turtles and so many more! 

 Soar to great heights with a diverse mix of bright & brilliant fully flying birds including the vibrant Toco Toucan and majestic Secretarybird. House your birds in fully customisable aviaries built from barriers, support poles and dynamic mesh covers, allowing them to...

store.name: Halloween: The Game
store.short: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.
store.about:
Take The Shape of Evil: Target, stalk, and terrorize the residents of Haddonfield as the iconic Michael Myers.

 Become a Hero of Haddonfield: Arm yourself with weapons and everyday household items to fend off the impending evil, alert the authorities, and rescue the innocent families of Haddonfield.

 Experience the Ultimate Horror Sandbox: An expansive array of dynamic map features, distinct gameplay systems, life-like NPC interactions, and player abilities elevates the horror sandbox like never before.

 Singleplayer Slashing: Immerse yourself in the haunting narrative events of "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story.

 Elevated Asymmetrical Multiplayer: Cooperate with up to four players as the Heroes of Haddonfield and face off against the one and only Michael Myers in unpredictable multiplayer matches unfolding within a living, breathing game world.

 It’s Halloween night, 1978, the unsuspecting families of the quiet suburban town of Haddonfield are making holiday preparations, and evil has made its way home. Take The Shape of Evil as Michael Myers or save your neighbors as a Hero of Haddonfield in Halloween, the ultimate asymmetrical horror sandbox. 
 As Michael, players wear the mask, become the Boogeyman, and stalk innocent residents with relentless obsession. Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Frightened townsfolk will call the local authorities and even fight back when...

store.name: Am I Nima
store.short: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.
store.about:
You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her. 
 Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.
 As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.

 However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories. 
 When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth? 

 The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

store.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
store.short: Umamusume: Pretty Derby, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!
store.about:
-- Umamusume. They are born to run. They inherit otherworldly names, and are inspirited by dreams most dramatic and wonderful. Now, they run ever forward. That, is their destiny. No one knows how the races that lie in their futures will end. Even so, they continue to run, aiming only toward the goal in front of them.
 -- Each and every one of the runners sports a unique charm. It's up to you, the trainer, to lead them down the path of victory! You have but one goal—raise your Umamusume to her fullest potential and help turn her greatest dreams into reality. In order to reach these newfound heights, it's your job to participate in—and win—as many races as possible! Triumph awaits those who train hard and work to communicate. Only by cooperating will you take the crown!
 -- Experience the thrilling stories of historic racers, such as:
 Special Week (Voice: Azumi Waki)
 Silence Suzuka (Voice: Marika Kono)
 Tokai Teio (Voice: Machico)
 Oguri Cap (Voice: Tomoyo Takayanagi)
 Gold Ship (Voice: Hitomi Ueda)
 Vodka (Voice: Ayaka Ohashi)
 Daiwa Scarlet (Voice: Chisa Kimura)
 Mejiro McQueen (Voice: Saori Onishi)
 Symboli Rudolf (Voice: Azusa Tadokoro)
 Rice Shower (Voice: Manaka Iwami)
 Haru Urara (Voice: Yukina Shuto)
 Nice Nature (Voice: Kaori Maeda)
 ...and so many more—over 20 Umamusume are searching for a trainer to help them achieve their goals!
 -- Cheer for your favorite Umamusume and immerse yourself in exhilarating races and stunning performances in breathtaking 3D graphics. Up to 18 Umamusume compete in races against each other for first place—watch them go as you tune in...

store.name: The CUBE
store.short: The Cube is an MMO RPG shooter. A giant, levitating Cube with rotating rows and edges. Hidden within is an unknown equation capable of altering the laws of reality. Can you survive another turn?
store.about: The CUBE is a multiplayer RPG-shooter that blends unique world-building, an intriguing narrative, and exciting quests into one game. A living world full of memorable characters, diverse biomes, and tons of enemies, including powerful bosses, awaits you.

store.name: EXODUS
store.short: Step forward into EXODUS™ — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

store.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
store.short: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.
store.about:
Ten years ago, a mysterious giant labyrinth suddenly appeared on the surface of the world. It stretched endlessly into the depths, filled with ancient ruins and terrifying monsters. Adventurers from every land flocked to explore it, chasing fame and fortune in this new age of glory.
 But for you, the labyrinth known as the “Abyss” is not just an adventure. It is your only hope.
 Your beloved sister, Mio, suffers from a rare illness that no doctor can cure. The only clue to saving her lies somewhere deep within the Abyss. Every day, you descend alone into its dark dungeons, risking your life for her sake while she waits patiently at home.
 As the days pass, the Abyss only grows more dangerous.
 Will you find the cure before it is too late, or will the depths claim you first?

 This is primarily a sister life-sim. Spend time with Mio at home: chatting, watching anime, cooking, and sharing the small joys of daily life, with fully animated and voiced scenes. Your care choices shape her mood and unlock new absolutely wholesome events!
 When it is time to pursue the cure, head into the Abyss for focused roguelite runs. Battle monsters, learn skills, gather loot, and push a little deeper before returning home. Each outing supports your simple life together, and each evening brings you closer to the cure Mio needs.

 Life with your Sister 
 After adventuring, return home to enjoy simple life downtime. Whip up meals with gathered ingredients, share adventure tales, play games, or snooze side by side! As you get closer, unlock more interactions!
 Animations 
 Enjoy a wide range of...

store.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
store.short: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.
store.about:
Welcome to Los Santos
 When a young street hustler, a retired bank robber, and a terrifying psychopath find themselves entangled with some of the most frightening and deranged elements of the criminal underworld, the U.S. government, and the entertainment industry, they must pull off a series of dangerous heists to survive in a ruthless city in which they can trust nobody — least of all each other.
 Current PC players can transfer both GTAV Story Mode progress and GTA Online characters and progression with a one-time migration from the legacy version of GTAV to GTAV Enhanced. 
 Stunning Visuals
 Enhanced levels of fidelity and performance with new graphics modes including ray tracing features such as ambient occlusion and global illumination, ray traced shadows and reflections, support for AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS, and more.*
 Faster Loading
 Quicker access to the action as the world of Los Santos and Blaine County load in faster than ever before by using SSD and DirectStorage on supported devices.
 Immersive Controls
 Feel new levels of responsiveness with dynamic resistance via the Adaptive Triggers on the DualSense™ wireless controller, from directional damage to weather effects, rough road surfaces to explosions, and much more.*
 3D Audio
 Enhanced audio with support for Dolby Atmos and improved fidelity of speech, cinematics, and music.* Hear the sounds of the world with pinpoint precision: the throttle of a stolen supercar, the rattle of neighboring gunfire, the roar of a helicopter overhead, and more.
 Grand Theft Auto Online
 Experience GTA Online, a dynamic and...

store.name: R.E.P.O.
store.short: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.
store.about:
R.E.P.O. is an online co-op horror game featuring physics, proximity voice chat and scary monsters. You and up to 5 friends can venture into terrifying environments to extract valuable objects using your physics-based grabbing tool.

 Even the monsters are affected by Newton's law of gravity! 
Under the employ of a mysterious computer intelligence. It is your job to locate, transport and extract valuable items from the haunted remains of a long lost humanity.

 ...but know when to stay quiet. 
Transport anything from heavy pianos to fragile ceramics and use teamwork to make sure that the precious cargo will safely reach its destination.

 Robotic enhancements increase your chances! 
Use your hard earned cash [SURPLUS] to purchase upgrades and weapons from your heartless [GENEROUS] creator.

store.name: Hello Sunshine
store.short: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.
store.about:
"They sold us a brighter future. They delivered the end of the world." 
 Hello Sunshine is a mystery survival RPG set in the sun-scorched ruins of a corporate empire. You play the final employee . Your mission: reach the tower at the end of the road, and help decide the fate of what remains of this world.
 To survive the blistering heat and deadly sun, you'll walk in the shadow of a towering war machine, scavenging for supplies and searching for pieces to the puzzle.
 When the sun sets and the robot stops to charge, you'll  make camp, craft new gear, and repair your mechanical guardian. But the wasteland is freezing cold at night. Stay close to the robot to keep warm.
 The journey to the tower is long. You won't make it on your own. As the sun rises, the robot starts walking. Follow — and stay alive until the end of the road. 

 "Walk in the shadow of a giant robot" 
 The sun is your enemy. The robot’s shadow provides protection from the heat and radiation. Stay in the shade or risk exposure — but the further into the wasteland you venture, the greater the rewards.
 "Survive the freezing nights" 
 The wasteland turns bitterly cold after sundown. After the robot stops to recharge at a Sunshine Service Station, you must stay close to keep warm. Make camp, cook food, craft new gear, upgrade your equipment — and keep an eye out for visiting strangers, for appearances can deceive.

 "Repair, customise, upgrade your mobile base" 
 The wandering robot is more than a companion — it’s your lifeline. Enhance it with improved sensors, defensive systems, and mechanical upgrades. Add...

store.name: Mycopunk
store.short: Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission based looter shooter. Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?
store.about:
A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

Embark on a series of dangerous planet-side missions to drive back the mycological menace. Could this be a simple natural disaster like they claim? And did SAXON really misfile your taxes? Or was that your own fault?

Choose from an outrageous arsenal of advanced futuristic weaponry (and some power tools), then supercharge them in a one-of-a-kind grid-based upgrade system to create the ridiculous sci-fi super-weapon of your dreams.

Slaughter hordes of enemies as they corrupt and weaponize the planet's technology against you. Pick crawlies apart piece by piece — but be wary, whatever they drop could be grabbed up by another enemy.

Every mission grants new mods to jam into your upgrade grids. Mix em, match em, and stack em. Whatever upgrades you can fit in are fair game. Piece by piece, your scrappy robots and weapons mutate into finely-tuned death machines (or horrible mistakes of engineering, up to you). Spec into being a healing support, put a deflector shield on a chainsaw, or turn yourself into a bomb (we don't really care).

Let off steam between missions in an orbital dropship packed with toys and games. Hang out with your friends, uncover more about the galaxy, and shoot the breeze with the insectoid SAXON veteran Roachard Cox.

store.name: Bergfried
store.short: Build realistic medieval castles and defend them against rival knights. Bergfried is a strategy game featuring organic castle building and tactical siege battles. Manage your lands, plan your defenses and lead your troops to victory!
store.about:
Bergfried is a strategy game set in a colorful, believable medieval world, where you build and defend unique, organic castles.
Prepare layered defenses and command your troops to withstand enemy attacks. Expand strategically and manage your resources carefully to survive prolonged sieges.

 Bergfried offers an organic castle-building experience on a unique grid that captures the irregular shapes of European castles from the high and late middle ages.

 Build castles that follow the contours of the landscape, taking full advantage of natural defenses or impose strict geometric layouts to fortify your domain.
 Plan your defenses carefully to withstand attacking armies and long sieges.
 Strategically place towers and gatehouses, and position troops on the ramparts.

 Gather resources and manage your economy to construct castles, villages and towns.
 Expand your territory to gain control of key resources and strengthen your position.
 Adapt to dynamic events like the market day, tournaments or the king visiting your castle.

 Command your troops in tactical field battles and intense castle sieges.
 Recruit archers, crossbowmen, spearmen, men-at-arms, and knights.
 Use the tactical pause feature to issue commands without time pressure.

store.name: Grave Seasons
store.short: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.
store.about:
Grave Seasons is an isometric pixel murder mystery farming/life sim, where you play the role of an escaped convict attempting to live peacefully in the small mountainside town of Ashenridge. Unfortunately, things take a turn for the worse when a supernatural serial killer begins attacking your fellow neighbors. 

 Grave Seasons is a narrative-driven supernatural horror wrapped lovingly in a farming/life sim. You will have one year to protect victims from a supernatural serial killer that lurks in town. Using farming , foraging , crafting and investigation , you are tasked with discovering methods that ward off monsters. Unravel the truth behind the supernatural murders, discover the secrets the residents of Ashenridge keep hidden away, and save those that you can…

 Or let chaos reign. The choice is yours.  

 Just know that each decision has its consequences, both positive and negative. Unlock new stories upon the death of characters, discover storylines with their survival. Decisions are checked (and autosaved) to weave a story of your time in Ashenridge. With only a year, how will you leave your mark?

 Inspired by farming sims of old, your farm in Ashenridge sits at the very top of the mountain. There you can: 
 Farm and grow seasonal crops using different types of farm plots

 Craft recipes in your kitchen or your shed, as well as mysterious occult items that could save potential victims of the killer

 Upgrade your tools and the buildings on your farm and select potential aesthetic customization options

 Unearth pieces of history in Ashenridge as you farm, harvest...

store.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady
store.short: Plutobell is in trouble! Help Rei-Bo in this action-platformer full of challenges and traps, filled with of cute and silly characters. Choose the stage order, get new weapons as you defeat each boss and test all your skills in RoboGAL!
store.about:
In RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady you'll help Rei-Bo investigate a spaceship that has crash-landed on Plutobell which will be full of all kinds of traps and enemies! Jump, shoot and slide to overcome all the obstacles in the game.

 Here you'll be free to choose where on the spaceship you start! Each stage will have unique visuals, traps and unique enemies. Choose which challenge suits you best! 

 At the end of each stage you'll face one of the bosses in the game. Defeat each of them and get their weapons which will help make many of the challenges much easier. A tip: Each boss contains a weakness that will make the battle easier!

 RoboGAL is designed to please those looking for a good challenge, but there will also be room for those who are learning. We've made a challenge that's just right for both those who want a more casual experience and 2D game veterans!

store.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
store.short: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
store.about:
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. ◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. ◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices. ◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization. ◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.

store.name: Stage Fright
store.short: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.
store.about:
From the creators of the worldwide sensation OVERCOOKED! comes “Stage Fright”, an all new co-operative experience for 2 players. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery. 

 A Co-Op Adventure ...
 Stage Fright is built from the ground up as a co-operative experience, bursting with Overcooked-style chaotic moments and escape room-esque co-operation. Play online or better still, side-by-side.

 ... with Pick-up-and-play Accessibility ...
 Designed with communication and team work in mind and instantly accessible to a wide array of players. The challenge is in the mind, not the finger-tips!

 ... in an Intriguing and Mysterious Town
 Guide Drew, Blake and Charlie through a charming coming-of-age story with real heart and memorable characters. Switch between pairs of kids as the story unravels from two unique perspectives.

store.name: 4 Penny Coffins
store.short: In 4 Penny Coffins, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence in our online multiplayer mode. This social investigation game also includes a solo mode for those brave enough to face the fog alone.
store.about:
The streets are dangerous. Fear spreads with every body found. In 4 Penny Coffins , one player takes on the role of the Ripper - a demonic murderer with the urge to kill - while others work to uncover the truth before the next murder.

 A new take on the typical social deception genre! 
 Gather evidence from crime scenes, question suspects, track suspicious behavior, and piece together clues. The Ripper must deceive and redirect suspicion while avoiding detection. Investigators must separate fact from fiction before paranoia tears the group apart.
 Trust is fragile. Evidence can be faked. And time is not on your side.

 Each night follows a deliberate three-phase cycle.
 The Ripper hunts. Players investigate. Then, in a formal and organized Conviction phase, evidence is weighed and a verdict is delivered. No endless shouting. No stalled discussions. Every round reaches a resolution.

 With dynamic roles and player-driven outcomes, every session unfolds differently. Playable solo or in multiplayer, 4 Penny Coffins blends social deduction with investigative mechanics to create tense, unpredictable matches where trust is earned slowly and lost instantly. Someone will hang for these crimes. Make sure it isn’t you.

store.name: Paradise
store.short: PARADISE is a free-to-play life simulation game with limitless possibilities, realistic graphics, and advanced AI. Endless World, Endless Play.
store.about:
Limitless possibilities 
 PARADISE® is a life simulation game with limitless possibilities. 
Play with your friends, engage in shootouts, race cars, complete daily missions, and reach the apex of life. Earn money and buy what you want, from real estate to fancy clothes. 
Endless World, Endless Play.
 AI-Powered NPCs 

 Every NPC in the open world is more than just a background character. You can communicate with them using chat or voice. They have real voices, emotions, and reactions to your actions, making them behave like true living people. Each NPC has their own backstory, job, and daily routine.
 Real-World Simulation 
 In PARADISE, we have recreated an entire island nation with every attribute of the real world, ranging from cityscapes with skyscrapers and bustling urban areas to serene oceans, beaches, and lush tropical forests. The game features different districts and natural zones, each meticulously detailed to enhance realism. 
 Our world is populated with diverse races and body types, bustling with cars that adhere to traffic laws, and vibrant with shops, nightclubs, and industrial properties.
 Players can engage in a realistic economy with the in-game currency, PAR, face consequences of crimes, and pursue relationships, mirroring the complexities of real life.

store.name: THE LIFT: Supernatural Handyman Simulator
store.short: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.
store.about:
The Institute was humanity's most advanced research facility – until a catastrophic incident left it drifting through the void, plagued by cosmic decay and slowly fading into oblivion along with its dark secrets. 
 Awakened from stasis, you must restore the Institute and uncover what went wrong. 
 The Lift is a first-person simulator where satisfying handyman gameplay meets a mysterious sci-fi story . 

 Every floor is a massive renovation project with unique challenges. Work at your own pace, tackling everything from basic furniture repairs to complex electrical engineering projects. Use a variety of gadgets, craft what you need, and bring the Institute back to its former glory.

 Use the Lift as your mobile base while travelling across the Institute. Explore multiple biomes, unlock hidden areas, meet unforgettable characters, and complete their quests. Piece together the mind-bending truth behind the incident that changed everything.

 Breathe life back into dozens of intricate devices from vending machines and generators to satellite dishes and supercomputers. Build circuits with multiple components, identify fault currents, route cables, manage power supply, and generate torque to repair each system.
 KEY FEATURES 
 - Satisfying handyman simulator + immersive narrative-driven adventure
 - Massive research complex to explore and renovate
 - Complex electrical engineering projects
 - Your own toolbox full of weird but useful gadgets 
 - Recycling-based crafting system
 - Highly interactive world inspired by Soviet retrofuturism
 - Memorable, fully voiced characters with...

store.name: Tides of Annihilation
store.short: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.
store.about:
The world has been left fractured by a sudden invasion from The Otherworld. As Gwendolyn, a survivor of the calamity, you will venture through a broken London where reality and fantasy bleed into one another, confront foes from beyond, and unveil the secrets of both worlds.
 Save a Shattered London on the Brink of Annihilation 
 The Otherworld, of unknown origin, has descended upon London without warning. Streets and landmarks twist and crumble without end. The whole city is being torn asunder, slowly merging into The Otherworld.
 As the one who endured it all, you will face the invasion head-on, delve through richly layered levels, unearth the truth of the catastrophe, and find a way to save your family, the city, and perhaps the entire world.

 Claim the Power of Knights, Forge Your Own Knight Set 
 You will encounter over a dozen legendary Knights of the Round Table drawn from Arthurian legend on your journey. Each wields distinct combat roles and abilities — ranging from vanguard charges and steadfast defense to explosive burst damage.
 You can assemble your knight set according to tactical needs or personal preference, crafting diverse combat builds. This not only yields fluid, ever-shifting combo chains but also gives rise to profound tactical depth.
 You will reshape battlefield dynamics, and never fight alone again.

 Encounter the Spectacular Colossal Knights Roaming the World 
 Towering like mountains, the Colossal Knights wander between worlds. They are far more than majestic sights to be admired from afar — they are vast, silent arenas waiting to be stepped...

store.name: ReVamp
store.short: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.
store.about:
You are Dracula. Not a monster in the shadows, but the sovereign of a castle under siege. Cursed by Achlys, goddess of the night, you are condemned to defend your throne without end. Mortals return night after night, and every siege becomes another chapter in an eternal war of blood and sacrifice. But you do not merely watch from afar. You move through your halls, strike down invaders with devastating abilities, and tip the balance of battle when your forces begin to falter. All for the love that was taken from you.

 The castle is yours to shape. Expand it room by room, reconfigure its structure between attacks, and transform open halls into calculated gauntlets. Each room alters the flow of battle, forcing invaders into choke points, layered defenses, and brutal confrontations. Invest the blood of fallen mortals to strengthen your fortress, empowering chambers, enhancing effects, and acquiring new units. With every placement and every upgrade, the labyrinth deepens, becoming less a structure… and more a weapon.

 Mortals march in waves, blinded by a foolish sense of justice. Armored knights, unyielding barbarians, or zealous priests, each deserving a punishment tailored to their arrogance. Your answer? An army of the night. Skeletal swordsmen and archers form disciplined ranks, while swarming rats flood narrow corridors and winged harpies strike from above.

 When your legion wavers, step into the fray yourself. Move through the castle as Dracula and unleash devastating special abilities, and turn certain defeat into victory. The better you build, the more lethal you...

store.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
store.short: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.
store.about:
Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School is the sequel to the award-winning Escape Academy, enjoyed by over 4 million players!
 Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.
 DIGITAL ESCAPE ROOMS DESIGNED BY MASTERS OF THE CRAFT 

 Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School features an all-new campaign boasting handcrafted, best-in-class escape rooms built by our team of veteran puzzle designers. But unlike real-life escape rooms, the puzzles in Escape Academy aren’t bound by those stuffy safety regulations: Spiked ceilings? Check. 100 foot drops? Check. And, most-dreaded of all… Final exams? Double check.
 The curriculum here at the Academy is equal parts life-threatening and wacky, because what better way to learn than while confronting one's mortality.
 EXPLORE A LIVING CAMPUS  

 In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the * vibes* that student life has to offer. 
 Whatever the case, the Academy’s your new home away from home.
 GRAB A CLASSMATE AND GET ESCAPIN’ WITH ONLINE OR COUCH CO-OP 

 Escaping with a friend has never been this fun. Escape Academy 2 features both online...

store.name: Night Plane
store.short: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.
store.about:
YOU WORK AS A FLIGHT ATTENDANT 
 Plane Airlines™, 1999. It’s your first day on the job. Board passengers, attend to their needs and make sure their last trip is as enjoyable as possible.
 Somehow, it all weighs upon you.

 WE ONLY SERVE HUMAN CUSTOMERS 
 Shape-shifting entities may attempt to board. Check tickets, question passengers, and find a way to remove any unauthorized non-human visitors from the plane.
 The company will not be held accountable for any mistakes you make. You live with them.

 NEVERENDING MEMORIES WITH PLANE AIRLINES™ 
 Working as a flight attendant means representing the company at all times.
 Passengers may require assistance inside the plane, outside the plane, and in places not listed in your training manual.

 Your flight may encounter turbulence while you are on duty.
