store.name: Trash Day
store.short: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure for up to 6 players. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen wagon, and haul it to Raccoon Paradise. Live your best raccoon life.
store.about:
Every raccoon dreams of Raccoon Paradise. Unfortunately, you and your friends are currently locked up in Animal Control. 
 Break out, steal a wagon, load it with the finest trash you can find, and haul it across six areas to get there. Played the demo? That was only one area! The full game adds five more, new obstacles, and a full soundtrack. Online co-op for up to 6 players. You technically can play solo… but the wagon is a lot for one raccoon.

 The path ahead is tricky and full of challenges! Push and steer the wagon with up to five friends and clear the path ahead. Lose a wheel? Put it back on. Flip it? Flip it back. Distract animals on their own turf!

 Use bungee cords, planks, and more to propel your wagon over, under, and through traffic, bear traps, rockslides, and a river. Good plan. Terrible execution.

 Knock over trash cans, search dumpsters, and scour everything from Animal Control, through the wilderness, on the way to the junkyard for helpful items as well as valuable trash.

 Climb, scurry, and scamper your way through the world. Wear a hat. Stack your friends. Launch one off a seesaw. Play pattycake with a friend. Eat some junk.

 Made by Off By One Games, a small team with over a decade of experience working together on Rocket League.

store.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
store.short: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.
store.about:
Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new cutscenes and story moments, plus expanded voice-over and language support. ​Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more. ​

 On the continent of Pywel, the rival factions of Pailune maintained a tense balance. At Kliff's side stood his steadfast Greymane comrades, but a devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent.
 Kliff—having lost his family in all but name—is determined to reunite with the survivors and rebuild the faction.
 But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff will meet those who seek to upend the very order of the continent and face a mission unlike any he has ever known.

 Welcome to Pywel. 
 Here you'll find stretches of natural beauty and wilderness—from green plains and woods to arid deserts and rugged mountains—alongside bustling cities and quiet hamlets inhabited by residents from all walks of life. Between destinations, you will come across landmarks, ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and other points of interest that will draw your curisoity to wander. Your journey will also inevitably take you skyward to the mysterious realm known as the Abyss, where a mystical imbalance endangering the world must be restored.

 The world is yours to explore as you will and there are many paths for you to...

store.name: Culdcept BEGINS
store.short: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.
store.about:
Led by dice. Ruled by cards

 ●What is Culdcept? 
 It is a game where you move across the board, claim territories, and build strategies using cards.
 Use summons and magic to fight your way to victory.

 ●Story 
 Bavrashka, a continent created by the gods.
 At its center lies the Royal Cept Academy, an insitute where Cepters are trained to wield the power of stone tablets known as "Culds," fragments of the Culdcept.
 Kamur, who transferred to the Cept Academy, has his abilities recognized and is selected for the Royal Cepter Guard Regiment.
 Amid battles that threaten the continent, the power of a Cepter begins to awaken.

 ●Game System 
 Move with dice and battle with cards—
 This is a board game where victory hangs on a mix of luck and strategy.
 Experience a more accessible evolution of Culdcept that stays true to the series’ charm.​

 ●Card 
 Over 400 cards with all-new visuals.
 Combine all kinds of cards to win through the power of your own tactics.​

 ・Creature Cards 
 These are cards that allow you to summon creatures.
 They can help you gain more domains, or take over enemy domains.
 There are five elements, and each card has different abilities.

 ・Item Cards 
 Item cards support your creatures in battle.
 And that's not to say they simply help creatures attack and defend better.
 Using the special abilities of items can help you snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!

 ・Spell Cards 
 Spell cards can help you build momentum, or put your opponents in a difficult position.
 Use them right and you can even turn the tides of the game in the blink of an eye.
...

store.name: Carcass Clad
store.short: A visceral co-op tank horror game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Featuring weighty physical controls, crew the Yksiö with a team of 3. Fuel is limited and ammo is scarce. The city's saint, long since laid to rest, walks again – gilded and defiled.
store.about:
Carcass Clad is a three person co-op game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Master tactile mechanics, communicate under intense pressure, and make your escape. Operating the Yksiö is fully diegetic, requiring each lever, action, and mechanism to be handled manually. Each member of your crew serves a unique role inside the tank. Every action matters. Every mistake spreads.

 Against all orders, the crew of the Yksiö have no choice but to cut through the city of Vhorgorod. With no allies left, the only way to survive is to scavenge the dregs of the Ostravyan defenses. What the few who still remain, the most obsessed of them, have accomplished left the streets sick with chimeric growths of gold and body. Masses of divine livestock are adorned onto the husks of their machines, to war again.

 Kanerva wanted above all an easy and glamorous life until the encroaching war forced her to enlist. Now the promise of a return to normalcy pushes her to become a ruthless commander. 
 Visibility in the Yksiö is extremely limited. As Kanerva, you are the eyes and ears of the tank. Use your periscope to identify and range targets. Listen to your radio and chart safe routes through the city, locate useful items and potential threats. Keep a cool head, especially during combat. The tank and your crew survive by your orders.

 A lackadaisical man more accustomed to survival within dodgy gambling dens than the battlefield, gunner Erkki’s aim is as sharp as his wit. 
 Make every shot count. As Erkki, you’re responsible for the Yksiö’s lumbering 158mm cannon. Use the inventory carousel to...

store.name: Arkheron
store.short: No two runs are ever the same. New loot, new enemies, new strategies, new memories. Arkheron is a fast-paced, isometric PvP where every item you grab rewrites how you play mid-fight. Take two friends up the Tower, pull off strats that shouldn’t work, and fight your way to the next floor.
store.about:
"Find me next cycle. I will remember you." 
 — Karriv, the Forge

 The horn sounds. The Tower calls. How will you choose to fight? 
 Arkheron is a fast-paced, clip-worthy team PvP game where the items you equip dynamically change how you play. Grab your friends, loot Relics that change your build mid-fight, and climb a haunted Tower floor by floor. If you've played a shooter or a MOBA, your aim and your instincts already work here. The builds, the counters, the hundred ways a fight can turn all boils down to your adaptability and skill.
 The Climb 
 The Tower is caught in an endless cycle of destruction and renewal; your only way out is to make it to the next floor.
 Spires is where most runs start: your team of three against one other team, straight up. Gear up in the ready room, agree on a plan, and climb floor by floor. Each floor is a new fight with higher stakes, and a limited number of tries before your run resets.
 Ascension is the main event. Fifteen teams of three drop into the Tower together to fight monsters, contest rival squads, and grab beacons before time runs out. The field gets smaller every floor, until one team is left standing at the summit.

 What You Carry Defines You  
 In the Tower, loot takes the form of Relics: items that change how you fight the moment you pick them up. Swap them in and out as you climb.
 Go Full Set: collect all four Relics from one set to transform into an Eternal and unlock a fifth ability.
 Go Shattered: mix Relics from different sets and build something nobody else is expecting.

 Fast Paced, High Skill 
 Arkheron's...

store.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
store.short: Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.
store.about:
KEY FEATURES 

 Survive horrific Stalkers 
 Challenge your survival instinct to escape murderous enemies: hide, evade and fight back in critical moments. Every mistake can be fatal.

 Master Hypnosis Powers 
 Use retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation to read forgotten memories, reveal hidden paths and twist the environment to your advantage.

 A modern return to classic survival horror 
 Step into a love letter to classic 3rd person survival horrors, with modern pacing, controls and production values.

 Explore a richly detailed environment 
 Investigate every room, find clues and key items, and solve puzzles to access new areas and progress toward the final revelation.

 Uncover the secrets of the Cristo Morente 
 Discover the forgotten story of the Sicilian convent where the myth of the Red Nun began: a place of burned faith, buried guilt and forbidden rituals.

 Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy is a modern survival horror inspired by classic horror games, blending stealth and psychological horror with new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis and environmental manipulation, and closing the Red Nun’s story once and for all.

 ACCLAIMED MUSIC AND VOICE TALENT 

 Original soundtrack by legendary composer Akira Yamaoka & Aram Shahbazians 

 BAFTA Games Awards winner Cissy Jones as Susan

 The Game Awards winner Maggie Robertson as the Red Nun

 THE STORY 

 Sometimes, seeking the truth means losing yourself. 
 Over a year after some young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the...

store.name: KYORA
store.short: Delve into KYORA, a mystical multiplayer sandbox adventure, where every pixel is yours to shape, mine, build or explode.
store.about:
‎ ‎ 
From the creators of the multi-award-winning mining sandbox, Core Keeper , comes an all-new mystical multiplayer adventure… 
‎
Cross into a realm of ruins, where every pixel is a tool to create something new. Mine precious resources, craft physics-altering wands, take on powerful bosses, and build your base by terraforming the world around you.

 Journey into the unexpected, in a procedurally-generated open world. Carve into the earth or sculpt toward the sky in search of magical materials. Craft matter-manipulating wands, upgrade your gear, and take on the powerful bosses in control of each biome: the Heralds.
‎ ‎ 

 Let loose your sandbox creativity with pixel-by-pixel terraforming. Build bridges to new areas, sculpt and customise your dream base with pixel materials, or even use your terraforming powers mid-battle to construct platforms and cover. 
‎ ‎ 

 The world of KYORA is filled with secrets. The further you venture, the more dangers await. To survive KYORA’S forest-cloaked ruins and cross its blistering desert sands, you’ll need to use each biome’s resources to your advantage. Gather materials, forge powerful weapons and armour, plant seeds and cook up recipes to help you traverse the wilds...
‎ ‎ 

 It’s dangerous to go alone! Bring your buddies with you to combine skills, creating fun synergies between wand abilities, in up to 8-player online co-op gameplay.

store.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
store.short: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
store.about:
WendyQuest is 100% fresh and 100% human made!

 When mechanized monsters invade a culinary kingdom, it’s up to Wendy to save Savoria from mech-trouble. Welcome to WendyQuest, an epic original adventure where you earn real food as you play.
 Play as Wendy and battle Mech Corp’s mechs, solve puzzles, and embark on an epic quest to unite four magical stones to save Savoria. Will you restore order to a realm in peril? The fate of flavor is in your hands.

 Dr. Mechborg and his mechs have spread a curse called “Mechtosis” across Savoria using soggy fries, frozen beef & other culinary atrocities. Only Wendy - armed with sacred spatulas, fresh beef, and an ancient prophecy - can restore order to Savoria’s people and end the mechademic once and for all.

 Square off against flavorless foes like Golden Archers, Hot Sludge Sundaes and other fast food fiends in strategic turn-based battles. Time your attacks perfectly to deal supersized damage.

 Team up with tasty pals including a French Fry Archer, Spicy Chickeneer, Frosty Mage, and more. Each ally brings their own flavor to the table that deals extra damage against specific enemy types.

 Journey across five food-themed regions including salty forests, seasoned deserts, rugged beefy bluffs, and Frosty-capped peaks - each filled with hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

store.name: The Hidden Ones
store.short: The Hidden Ones is a 3D cinematic action-fighting game that's an adaptation of the martial arts franchise The Outcast.
store.about:
The Hidden Ones is a 3D action fighting game featuring a myth-inspired martial arts aesthetic.

 Game Features
 Captivating Outcast stories and fast-paced combat 
 Unveil the ancient myths of the Outcast world and engage in electrifying combat across diverse game modes.

 Myth and martial arts combined in cinematic design 
 Experience unique Eastern martial arts combat, featuring enticing cinematic scenes inspired by an urban myth with ancient elements.

 Completely fair PvP experience 
 The core values of The Hidden Ones focus on ensuring fair competitive play and upholding a strict zero-tolerance policy against cheating.

 Game Modes
 Game Mode: Story 
 Various boss mechanics and designs reflect the different chapters of the mythical martial arts story. 
 Experience cinematic-style cutscenes and beautifully-designed levels that immerse players in the action. 
 Venture into the world of The Outcast through action-packed battles and explore the story from multiple perspectives.

 Game Mode: Duel 
 Engage in high-intensity battles and adapt in the blink of an eye. 
 By integrating other characters' skills into the action roulette, players can gain a game-changing advantage.
 Use unique skills and strategies in a fair and competitive environment.

 Game Mode: Trial Mode 
 Conquer all the epic bosses that emerge throughout the story mode.
 Battle bosses that grow stronger with each fight, mastering different characters and battle styles to prevail.

store.name: GIRLS' FRONTLINE 2: EXILIUM
store.short: Continuing the legacy of the Girls' Frontline world, this all-new adventure casts you as the Commander, challenging you to lead your squad of Tactical Dolls deep into perilous contamination zones and overcome enemies with tactical prowess.
store.about:
The end of an era, the dawn of another; the fall of a faction, the rise of another... The torchbearers shall shine upon the brave new world.
 After severing ties with G&K, the Commander bid farewell to the past and chose to venture into the contamination zones. During their journey, the Commander encountered more and more individuals and Tactical Dolls. Each with their own unique stories, they became indispensable members of the Commander's team. The Commander, who only sought to complete bounty missions smoothly and earn a stable income, was unexpectedly ambushed during what appeared to be a routine transport mission. Far from the bustling vortex, it became clear that the Commander had been drawn into an even larger maelstrom...
 Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium is a 3D strategy RPG for both PC and Mobile. In this game, you will fully experience:
 [Covenant Ring: Forge Unbreakable Bonds with Your Dolls] 
 Inscribe your Covenant and unlock exclusive archives, memories, and voice lines for your Dolls. Affinity can be deepened through gift-giving. A Covenant with your Dolls can be formed at a certain Affinity level, which unlocks an exclusive Covenant Projection.

 [Realistic Weapon System, Free-Form Weapon Customization] 
 Handguns, machine guns, shotguns—every type of weapon is available with a 360° preview. Freely attach weapon accessories to create a unique appearance for your weapons. Equip your team with the finest weapons to face the toughest enemies.

 [Immersive Animations, 360° Character Interaction] 
 Featuring high-quality character models with rich interactive...

store.name: Rat Game
store.short: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.
store.about:
OVERVIEW 📙
 Asymmetrical online co-op with 1 Chef vs 2 to 7 Rats

 Play against a human or robot-controlled Chef

 Interconnected map filled with tasks & secrets

 Around 3 hours of playtime

 OH, RATS!!!!!!!!!🐀
 Chef has been trying to exterminate the rats, leaving them no choice but to ruin his restaurant. Crawl through hidden shortcuts and hide in dark corners in a vast human-scale map. Work in teams of 2-8 to nibble through wires, clog the toilet, hack the PC – anything to get this place shut down for good!

 YOU’RE COOKED!!!!!!👨‍🍳
 Rats are destroying your treasured family restaurant. Stomp around listening for the tell-tale sound of scrabbling claws, waiting for the right moment to grab them and throw them in the cage. If all else fails, you also have a gun. Time for some pest control!

 DEFEAT THE ROBO-CHEF!!!! 🤖
 Co-op only mode sets you and your rat friends against the mighty mechanical Robo-Chef. He’s programmed to cook, clean… and to kill!

 Rat Game is an asymmetrical comedy horror with a dynamic soundtrack, an interconnected map, squeaky proximity chat, and plenty of cheese. Last one standing wins.

store.name: 4:LOOP
store.short: It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. Thankfully, that’s all part of The Plan.
store.about:
It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. Thankfully, it’ll take more than death to stop you.
 You’re one of four seemingly ordinary people who mysteriously survived an alien invasion that turned most of humanity to glass. With a moon-sized mothership looming overhead, killer robots hunting you down, and mutated flora and fauna spreading across the planet, you’re led to a crashed alien ship by an eccentric scientist. He claims the same tech he used to predict the invasion led him to find you - because you’re the only ones who can stop what comes next.
 Armed with an arsenal of mind-bending weapons and machines—including the ability to “reprint” your fallen teammates—it’s up to you to destroy the mothership before the invaders’ global mining operation grinds the planet to dust.
 When you fail, death isn’t the end. It’s a chance to regroup, adapt, and finally save the world. Drop into dynamic missions packed with ever-changing environments, emerging objectives, and escalating threats. 
 Experiment. Improvise. Beat the odds. 
 With every attempt, you’ll unlock new gear, uncover the invasion’s secrets, and push ever deeper into the unknown.

store.name: PRAGMATA
store.short: Pragmata is a unique, sci-fi action-adventure game from Capcom. Follow Hugh, a member of an ill-fated investigation team, and Diana, a young android, as they navigate a lunar facility taken over by rogue AI in search of a way to Earth.
store.about:
"Wherever you go, I'll be there." 

Pragmata is a unique, sci-fi action-adventure game from Capcom.

Follow Hugh, a member of an ill-fated investigation team, and Diana, a young android, as they navigate a lunar facility taken over by rogue AI in search of a way to Earth. ONE TRAGIC ACCIDENT. AN UNLIKELY DUO. 

At a remote lunar research facility, humanity discovers a new ore—one that, when properly refined, can be used to create almost anything using 3D printers. 

When the facility suddenly falls silent, Hugh and his team are dispatched to investigate...but then disaster strikes.

Hugh is saved by Diana, a lone android wandering the complex. The two of them must join forces to find a way off the moon while working their way through an AI-controlled facility bent on stopping them.

Half-realized replicas of human civilization sprawl across the lunar surface, while inside, only scattered traces of the facility's vanished inhabitants remain. What buried truth awaits at the end of Hugh and Diana's journey?

 TAKE CONTROL OF TWO CHARACTERS—AT THE SAME TIME. 

Guide both Hugh as he moves, shoots, and jumps, and Diana, who hacks at the same time.

Enjoy a fresh, new blend of gameplay in this truly unique system that will push your brain to its limits.

store.name: Giggleland
store.short: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.
store.about:
Booting up Assistant... 
 Loading Eliot... 

 O-oh! Hi there!

 Heheh, it's been a while since I've met another kid! I'm Eliot, your Giggleland guide. Welcome to the place where smiles are forever!

 This is Tolie. She doesn't talk, but she knows how to listen, and that makes her the best kind of friend. Her dad is waiting for her somewhere in the park, so first we're going to see Farmer Terry. He loves helping children find their way home!

 There are only a few rules. Stay on the path. Stay where I can see you. And if a door says Staff Only, don't go in there. It's against the rules. You'll get in trouble!

 Attention, guests. If you have seen a little girl wearing a white dress and a pink hat, please notify the nearest staff member immediately. 

 Explore all of Giggleland across eight chapters, from Farmer Terry's farm to the tunnels beneath the park.

 About six hours of first-person psychological horror, in one complete game.

 Uncover a story of family, belonging and the true cost of endless happiness, told by a fully voice-acted cast.

 Giggleland does things no other horror game has done, and some of them happen outside the game. The full game is safe to stream * .
 * Giggleland is safe to stream and record, no streamer mode needed. Just capture the game window instead of your whole screen.

store.name: Zeverland
store.short: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!
store.about:
Welcome to Zeverland! Yep, another zombie game. But here, common sense is your best weapon. Just like in real life, you can interact with and modify anything you find. Dismantle a gas station toilet, attach a Zed head to a baseball bet to make a deadly weapon, or weld a bed into an RV so you can drive your house wherever you want.
 Worried about getting bitten? Don't worry, undead doesn't mean no life! Don't want to get your hands dirty? Gather NPCs from across the world to help you build your post-apocalypse shelter from the ground up.
 Once you've solved the problem of survival, you can choose to wander alone, or team up with others to think big: rebuild bridges, create a vaccine, build a skyscraper, and light up the world once more!

 Someone hit the pause button on civilization... 
 Everything is gone. Or is it?
 This isn't the aftermath of the apocalypse. This is the first minute of it.
 Sure, the water's still running... if you fancy a night of gut-wrenching agony.
 Your neighbor's lights are on, but they've got a bit of a zombie problem.
 And it's a commuter's dream right now because traffic laws are dead!
 Don’t think of this as the end of the world. Think of it as the first, chaotic day of a new one.

 Common sense. It's the new superpower. 
 To survive, don't overthink it.
 Thirsty? Bust open a vending machine.
 Hungry? Raid someone's pantry.

 Bitten? Welcome to the undead club.
 No complex rules. No punishing mechanics. Just do what makes sense to you.

 Common Sense + Imagination = Survival. 
 Get creative! Any junk you have is ready to be fused into a...

store.name: PC Cafe Simulator
store.short: Run your own Korean PC cafe! From customer service to cooking and store management — experience life as a PC cafe owner. Start small, hire staff, expand your store, and deal with troublesome customers yourself! Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players.
store.about:
Build, run, and grow your very own PC cafe.

 PC Cafe Simulator is a management simulation game set in a Korean PC cafe—an internet cafe built for PC gaming. Become the owner of a PC cafe and grow it from a small shop into a popular place filled with customers. Play solo at your own pace, or team up with friends in co-op multiplayer for up to 8 players.

 Build Your Own PC Cafe 

 Purchase the furniture and equipment you need to run your PC cafe and decorate it your way.

 Use customization features to create an interior with the atmosphere you want.

 Cook and Serve a Variety of Food 

 No Korean PC cafe is complete without food! Cook the food your customers order and serve it to them yourself. Keep your customers satisfied with delicious meals and increase your sales.

 Order Supplies and Manage Your Inventory 

 Order the supplies you need for your PC cafe and receive deliveries.

 Manage the inventory needed to keep your store running. Stock up on the food your customers want and run your store efficiently.

 Realistic Customers and Staff 

 Customers will visit your PC cafe, sit down, play games, order food, and leave reviews based on their experience.

 If there are no customers, head outside and attract passersby to bring more people into your PC cafe.

 Rain or Shine 

 The sun rises and sets as time passes, and the weather changes from day to day.

 Deal With Troublemakers Yourself 

 Some customers may run away without paying or cause a scene. Deal with them yourself using a broom!

 Play Alone or With Friends 

 Run your PC cafe at your own pace in...

store.name: RPG Chess
store.short: A turn-based RPG, except it's also chess! Every capture becomes a 1v1 battle decided by stats, elements and abilities. Build your team, climb the roguelite campaign, or duel friends and CPUs.
store.about:
RPG CHESS - A TURN-BASED RPG, EXCEPT IT'S ALSO CHESS
Every capture triggers a battle. RPG Chess reimagines chess as a turn-based
strategy game with classic RPG combat: your pieces fight with stats, elements
and abilities, and the game is won by defeating the enemy King.

 EVERY CAPTURE IS A BATTLE
Move a piece onto an enemy and the board gives way to a 1v1 duel. Both sides
secretly queue two commands, then watch them resolve in speed order. Land a
knockout, or win on remaining HP when both pieces survive. Winner claims the
square. Damage carries across the game, so every fight you pick makes the
next one riskier. LEVEL UP BY PLAYING CHESS
Your pieces gain experience from moving on the board. Push a pawn up the file,
or position a bishop to threaten the King. Every move can level up your piece and
have it grow stronger, unlocking new abilities. 100+ ABILITIES ACROSS 6 ELEMENTS
Over 100 unique abilities, each with its own cinematic animation and effect.
A piece's primary ability sets its element, so every loadout choice is also a

store.short: These are the REAL girls’ games. Charlie (Charchar887) discovers Lacey's mid-2000s Flash games and their disturbing secrets. Enter the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the website's missing creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey and her friends!
store.about:
heyy, Grace here. 
 So, you want to know about Lacey’s games? 
 Ok, But just so you know, I have nothing to do with what people have been saying out there.
 Lacey’s Flash Games are the real girl games - or at least, that’s how they were marketed back in the day. Most of them are simple and intuitive point and click games. You interact with the environments, make choices, and unlock different endings depending on what you do. Sounds harmless, right?

 Just follow my instructions
 Each game takes place in its own themed environment. You might work at a pet shop, ride a skateboard, bake and decorate cakes, or help Lacey and her friends deal with one of their many problems.
 Your job is usually pretty simple.
 Read my instructions. Click on things. Make the right choices.

 Although sometimes doing the wrong thing is more interesting....
 Cute, colorful and completely normal
 The games are bright, friendly and full of cute little details. At least, they are supposed to be :)
 Look closely and you might notice that some things do not quite belong. A character might act strangely. An object might appear where it should not. The instructions might stop making sense.
 If something feels out of place, maybe it is better to ignore it....

 More than one ending
 Your choices can change how each game ends. Some endings are predictable. Others are not so much.
 Even I have no idea what Rocio hid inside some of these games, and I am not sure I want to know :p

 So, that is basically it
 Or at least, that is what I remember. 
 There might be a few things Rocio added without telling me,...

 With success comes the financial freedom to expand your reach, while earning the right to build world famous landmarks to demonstrate your achievements. Fall short, and you’ll be seeking efficiencies and improvements to propel your company forward.
 As your influence expands, the needs of every city become more challenging to fulfill. There's no such thing as one plan that works forever, you will need to adapt, overcome, and solve problems as they come up, balancing your desire for growth with the needs of the populations you serve.

Manage and optimize your vehicle fleet, balance maintenance costs, efficiency, and priorities. Resolve bottlenecks and meet the evolving demands of dynamic towns and a multitude of industries that operate on- and offshore. store.short: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Rise from the Ashes 
 In Ashes of the Singularity II players must choose between humanity, AI Substrate, or the Post-Human Coalition to determine the fate of our solar system. Speed and reflexes will not win the day, but rather the player’s ability to plan and execute powerful strategies to put forces and materials in the right place at the right time.

 Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields

 Multiplayer – Join friends or rivals in PvP or co-op battles online.

 Instant Action - Pick the battlefield of your choice and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the most experienced RTS developers in the industry.

 The War for the Soul of the Solar System

When the world drowned, only the light remained 
 After a cataclysm that swallowed continents and erased civilization, a handful of survivors discover a solitary lighthouse standing above the endless ocean. Around its glow, humanity makes its last stand.

 🏗 Radial City-Building – Expand your city outward from the lighthouse, constructing and optimizing structures in a dynamic, ever-growing settlement.

 Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse.
 And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening.
 Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future.
 As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey.
 Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover.
 Delve into an expansive world / Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew

Free yourself from stamina limits, dash and parkour on walls, take Flight, and ride a high-mobility expedition motorbike to enjoy open-world exploration. As the world of Solaris-3 unfolds, your lost memory begins to see its recovery through this ceaseless quest.

 Enjoy extreme battle experience / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat

store.short: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Once a mighty empire, the land now lies barren, consumed by an unrelenting cold. Twisted by the Emperor’s pact with the Void, its ruins are haunted by relentless revenants and eldritch horrors. Aboard an armored, steam-powered train, the Penitent Gardeners purge the land of the cursed, granting mercy to the lost and striking down the wicked, seeking salvation in the heart of the frozen desolation.

Your train is more than a refuge, it is your only way forward. As you explore the frozen wasteland, it will keep you moving and alive, carrying everything you need to survive. Fuel the Eden Engine, manage its power, and operate your train to explore further, scavenging what little remains of this world.

Beyond the tracks lies a world frozen in death, its ruins entombed in ice and time. Explore the wasteland for vital supplies, scavenge the remnants of abandoned settlements, and break into wreckage lost to the frost. Descend into treacherous depths where greater rewards come at a deadly cost.

The frost creeps into your bones, the blizzard blinds, slows, and suffocates. Heat is survival, ration it wisely. And in the silence of the snow, something else stirs…

 MANY MODES TO MASTER

store.name: HAEX

Start a new world for a fresh adventure, or jump into a friend's game fully geared up. Every world keeps its own story. Every character keeps its own progression.

 An extraterrestrial power journey 
 Discover a sentient cube that allows you to effortlessly gather resources and scan your surroundings. Upgrade it to level up its capabilities. Unlock powerful alien abilities as you progress, opening up new ways to traverse the world with moves like dashing and double-jumping.

 Plant alien seeds to reshape a sub-arctic open world  
 Find or craft alien seeds that let you transform your world, and open new possibilities. Planting them unlocks unique new areas and resources, but beware of the new threats you might unleash on your world.

 Find the science expedition that went silent in the mist 
 Unearth what happened. The further you go the more dangerous the world becomes. Meet a cast of characters across the world, each with their own insights about the events unfolding around you. 

 Survive the cold and build your survival skills  
 Cold kills. Hunger slows you down. Go too deep without the right gear and you won't come back. Enemies, resources, and secrets all evolve with depth, and so do the rewards. Discover and explore alien structures in your search for more skills to unlock and weapons to craft.

PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?

 WORK TOGETHER

 SURVIVE

 A NEW ISLAND EACH DAY 
 The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

store.name: DIG
store.short: A cozy online co-op digging game for 1-8 friends. Dig a hole in your sunny backyard, find ore and lost blueprints, craft lovely things in your workshop and ship them to customers around the world, who write back with letters and photos. No timers. Just dig.
store.about:
That satisfying, hypnotic dig feeling

 Dig a hole. Dig it together.
 Grab a shovel, call your friends and start digging in your own sunny backyard. DIG is a cozy first person co-op game for 1-8 players: scoop the soil, crack the stone and watch every block crumble under your tools. Take it slow, chat with your crew and see what's down there.
 Dig up treasure

 Layer by layer the hole gets deeper and richer. Coal, copper, iron, quartz, gold, emeralds and fossils glitter in the walls, and somewhere down there are rolled-up blueprints for things nobody makes anymore.
 Craft cozy things

 Back at the workshop, turn what you found into something lovely: planks at the saw, glass and bricks in the furnace, and from your blueprints copper kettles, lanterns, hourglasses, gramophones and more.
 Pack it. Ship it.

 Take orders at the terminal, pack the crates on the dock and call the cargo ship. Every delivery earns gold and reputation for the whole team and its shared skill tree.
 Read what they write back

 27 customers from all over the world order from your little yard: an ice cream maker planning a proposal, a lighthouse keeper who forgot how to talk to people, a little girl who draws your dock. Their stories continue in letters that arrive with the next ship, some with a photo of what you sent.
 Features
 1-8 player online co-op with lobbies, invite codes and drop-in join
 First person digging in a fully destructible, layered dig site
 7 ores plus fossils, and 30 lost blueprints to find and craft
 Saw, furnace, workbench and blueprint machine

store.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis

Experience the pinnacle of adventure with Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, a stunning reimagining of the 1996 genre-defining game.

store.name: Swords & Slippers
store.short: A character action roguelite set in a twisted fairytale. These princesses don't want a rescue - they want the heads of the evil stepmothers who stole their happily ever after. Come for the curves. Stay for the combos.

Stepmothers took the thrones. Princesses took up arms. Swords & Slippers is old-school character action with a roguelite kick. Fight as a squad of the fairytale heroines you know: reimagined, weaponized, and yours to lead.
 LOOK GOOD DOING IT

 EVERY PRINCESS IS A WEAPON
 Snow White crushes foes with a dwarven pickaxe. Red Hood is the wolf of her own story. Rapunzel's hair has a mind - and a mouth - of its own. No two heroines fight alike, and the roster grows alongside the rebellion.
 STEPMOTHERS DON'T FIGHT FAIR
 Armored knights and twisted creatures are only the beginning. Survive long enough, and you'll come face to face with the storybook legends of your childhood, reimagined as bosses built to break you.
 POWER UP BEFORE MIDNIGHT
 Every run begins at dawn. Arm your heroines with elemental powers and unleash them through skillful combat. Earn new powers and grow stronger as the hours pass. You'll need everything you've got by midnight, when enemies are deadliest and rewards richest.

Hell Express is a PvE isometric extraction shooter for 1-4 players, blending heart-pounding combat, high-risk treasure hunts, and strategic resource management in a world teetering between life and death.

Dive into the perilous depths of Limbo, complete dangerous deliveries, and scavenge for treasures to upgrade your gear and vehicles. But beware: every decision could mean the difference between survival and ruin.

 A high-stakes isometric extraction shooter: Intense combat, balanced tactical raids, resource gambles, and precision extraction timing under survival pressure.

 Gun customization system: Scavenge components to forge gear that defines your playstyle.

 A road trip adventure: Freely explore limbo with an armed and custom Hell Trekker.

 Unique art style & dark humor: Tell stories that grip your heart, explore life, death, and what lies between.

store.name: Where Winds Meet

Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

 Craft, architecture, astronomy, folk games and performance, medicine and healing – 16 systems come together to form an immersive ancient society.

 A Living Open-World History 
 Jianghu knows no bounds.
 Ancient landscapes, traditional crafts, stories drawn from history and realistic graphics come together to build a world true to the spirit of wuxia.
 Immerse yourself in the captivating Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of China, where epic battles and legendary tales shape the course of history. From the bustling imperial capital to the hidden wilderness, every path is filled with secrets and adventures.

 Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community

 Battle Brutal Bosses

 As your fame rises you will battle brutal bosses, heroes of the arena, armed to the teeth with every advantage at their disposal. The deck will be stacked against you but victory will bring you one step closer to Rome and a chance at freedom or revenge.
 Survive Ghastly Wounds

 Each day in the arena leaves you with new wounds to add to your misery. Struggle on with a painful limp, try to get by with a missing left eye or flail madly at hallucinations only you can see. store.name: Darkhaven
store.short: Darkhaven is a next-generation ARPG brought to you by many of the original creators of Diablo and Diablo II. Explore a procedurally generated and fully destructible open world unlike any other in this solo or multiplayer adventure.
store.about:
Darkhaven is a dark-fantasy isometric ARPG set in the aftermath of a total collapse of civilization. You are a survivor in a world where the wild lands and monsters have reclaimed the ruins of long-dead empires. To survive, you must venture beyond the safety of your meager stronghold to hunt the remnants of evil and become the hero this world awaits. Unearth items of legendary power, learn arcane skill trees, and master a combat system that rewards skill and positioning over simple stat-checks.

 Every Player’s Game is Unique 

 Darkhaven moves away from the disconnected, "hallway-and-room" logic of traditional random layouts. We use ecological rules to stitch together biomes, handcrafted points of interest, and terrain that make sense. Every world is unique, yet feels cohesive with a rich implied history. Exploration isn't just a path to the next set of mobs; it’s the discovery of a vast and living realm.

 Totally Dynamic Worlds 
 The terrain in Darkhaven is fully deformable. You can dig into the earth to harvest resources, discover hidden caves, tunnel through dungeon walls, or rebuild ruined fortresses. Drain lakes to uncover sunken ruins or redirect flows of lava to form an impassable moat. You can also build. Raise the earth to create islands, fortify defensive positions, and construct everything from bridges to entire settlements. The land is your dominion, and its destiny is in your hands. 

 Lurking Horrors

 Blood in the Arena
 Watch savage duels and team battles unfold in brutal auto-battler combat.

 Choose one to lead, then face the others one by one through a deadly 160-day tournament. Each rival Dominus has their own strengths, methods, and ways of disrupting your Ludus as you fight your way toward the grand final.

 Build Your Ludus

SpellChain: A First-Person Spell-Crafting Fantasy RPG

 At the core of SpellChain is a flexible spellcrafting system that lets you create, modify and chain spells together. Its inspired by the spellcrafting and silliness of  Magicka and the large scale destruction of Fictorum.  Let your creativity take over in first-person on-the-fly combat and discover powerful and unpredictable spellchains to help you on your magical crusade.

 Fast-paced action combat with large scale magical destruction

store.name: Clean Start

Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.
store.about:
In Clean Start , you clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering heartfelt stories through the objects you find. Piece together each room’s narrative, discover hidden secrets , and experience the satisfaction of tidying up spaces in this cozy puzzle game set in a country whose language you don’t fully understand.

 Experience satisfaction from tidying up spaces, without time pressure or stressful game overs. Sink into a highly satisfying activity and let yourself be drawn into a trance of warmth and comfort. Enjoy a relaxing puzzle experience that’s easy to pick up and offers a break from the stresses of everyday life.

 While dialogues provide context, the main story of each level is told through the discovery of interesting objects. Players must piece together the story, either to satisfy their curiosity or to help the clients with more than just a dirty apartment.

 Create your own cozy space in a rented apartment using items found while cleaning. Your conversations with your employers—and the gifts they give you—will vary depending on what you discover in each level.

 Relaxing, cozy and positive atmosphere.

 Satisfying gameplay with no time limits or game overs, but with multiple solutions and outcomes.
