store.name: Cozy Game Restoration
store.short: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.
store.about:
Cozy Game Restoration is about the quiet satisfaction of restoring something that matters. You’ll unwrap carefully sealed packages to discover old, battered video game cartridges. They'll be covered in stickers, markers, dust, and all the accumulation of time. Each one is different, flawed in its own way, and waiting to be brought back to life.

 RESTORE FORGOTTEN RETRO GAMES 
 Every cartridge is procedurally dirtied. Some have clean labels but cracked shells. Others are scuffed, drawn on, or covered in adhesive residue. Grime is layered. Dust, ink, discoloration, stickers, and scratches each require a different tool to remove. Surfaces stretch, smear, and lift as you work. It’s slow, tactile, and satisfying.

 LOOT BOXES BUT IN A GOOD WAY 
 Game cartridges will arrive inside mystery parcels sealed with tape. You’ll peel them open by hand, lifting the flaps, and wrestling with sticky tape to see what’s inside. Each game has randomized conditions and visuals, with 108 distinct titles inspired by classics from the 1980s to early 2000s.

 Some are common finds, but others can be much rarer. You’ll encounter regional variants of carts, sticker artwork, and even shells made of gold (or better). Every game you restore will bring you closer to completing your collection, and there’s always a chance something unexpected will show up.

 COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION 
 As you restore games, you’ll complete collection-based quests. This might be simple stuff like “collect three puzzle games”, or “two rare platformers”, but you’ll also see more unique things which work with the game’s...

store.name: OKU
store.short: Without art, our world is fading. As the lone apprentice to a vanished haiku master, you venture out into Japanese landscapes and capture their beauty in poetry to restore forgotten paths. Explore your legacy, meet other travelers on this meditative journey, and learn to appreciate art and nature.
store.about:
A Journey of Legacy and Loss 
 Become a traveling monk and follow in the footsteps of your departed Sensei, who set out on a final pilgrimage to restore a fading world.
 With little guidance, you inherit not only his path, but also the responsibility he left behind.
 In a world shaped by art and nature, something has begun to fade. Places once full of meaning lie abandoned, paths are sealed, and fewer people remain to remember what once was. The silence is not empty; it is filled with absence.
 As you travel through shifting seasons, you slowly begin to understand what has happened, and what it now means to carry this legacy forward.

 A World of Tradition 
 In this world, art is not decoration. It is connection.
 Poetry, music, ikebana, and tea ceremony are ways in which people preserve the relationship between humanity and nature. Yet something has begun to fade. Places are forgotten, paths are sealed, and traditions that once connected the world are slowly disappearing.
 As you journey onward, you will encounter fellow disciples and mysterious wanderers, each carrying their own stories, struggles, and relationship with the world around them.

 Poetry Shapes the World 
 Your words shape your journey.
 By observing your surroundings, you gather inspiration and form haiku-like poems that reflect what you see and feel. Through this act of expression, you will unlock hidden paths, open new areas, and restore forgotten places by giving them meaning once more.
 Your journey also becomes part of something larger.
 You will encounter poems left behind by other players, subtle...

store.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
store.short: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.
store.about:
Earn your cards. Discover what they become. 
 In Silberheim, you build your collection by playing – card packs are never sold. But your cards don’t stay the way you found them: through your choices and experiences, they evolve and become something uniquely your own.
 Battle in a tactically demanding collectible card game, uncover the stories and secrets of a world that keeps evolving, and write your own story through the cards you play.

 Your deck can be copied—but your cards can’t! Your decisions and actions determine which cards evolve, when they evolve, and how. This creates unique cards with individual abilities that tell your story and unlock new tactical possibilities. You will have to discover for yourself when and how these evolutions occur. Our community actively shares its findings. Join the discussion and contribute your own discoveries!

 Card packs can’t be purchased in Silberheim—you earn them by playing. Future card expansions will be offered as optional add-ons. The base game will remain fully playable and, thanks to its evolving cards, competitively viable. Because in Silberheim, it’s play to win , not pay to win.

 Experience a complex yet accessible card game where matches are not over after just two minutes. Command your cards across three rows and develop sophisticated tactics. In addition to the primary resource, Combat Morale, make use of a wide variety of secondary resources and adapt your decks to your personal playstyle.

 Discover the rich lore and fantasy world of Silberheim. Explore the lore text of every card and admire handcrafted artwork...

store.name: Bot Colony _redux
store.short: Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand! In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy. Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. Total conversational freedom.
store.about:
SEVENTEEN YEARS IN THE MAKING 
 The Bot Colony  concept was unveiled at GDC in March 2009, and the game was released to Early Access in 2014,  ahead of its time; the tech just wasn’t ready for the vision we had. We never stopped chasing it. Now, in 2026, Bot Colony _Redux finally delivers on the dream: a futuristic sci-fi narrative you play using unrestricted speech, talking to nuanced characters who respond with intelligence, humour, and emotion. This game has something for fans of many genres, and gives players the freedom to shape the story with their own words - every playthrough is unique! This isn’t “press X to select an answer.” This is actual conversation with no limits on what you can say as you play.
 We’ve integrated cutting-edge AI and voice tech (Azure STT, ChatGPT, Elevenlabs’ emotive TTS) into North Side's state-of-the-art natural language understanding (NLU) to create next-level immersion.  
 FREE TO START 
 You receive an initial allocation of LEKS to help you experience open-ended conversations with the characters. Generating unique responses to whatever you say uses cloud resources. Once you use your initial free allocation, you can purchase additional LEKS through Steam’s standard checkout to continue playing.
 Speak to Robots In 16 Languages! 
We hope to see a global community form around  Bot Colony _Redux's multilingual gameplay. You can use your microphone (or type) to speak to a dynamic cast of intelligent robots in your preferred language, and they'll answer you in that language. It's an exhilarating experience to listen to or read in a new...

store.name: Pal♡world! ~More Than Just Pals~
store.short: What lies inside the mysterious World Tree? An exciting school life filled with cute Pals! Will you remain friends or fall in love? Or dismantle and eat them...🍴 Your dream school romance starts here in this Palworld dating sim!
store.about:
This game contains horror elements. Please take care if you are sensitive to such content. 

 Located at the foot of the World Tree stands the prestigious Private Palpagos Academy!
 Starting today, you are a transfer student at this school.

 Will you make friends, become lovers… or—dismantle and eat them?
 Your relationships with the Pals are entirely up to you!

 Chat with your friends (Pals) and get to know them to grow closer!
 If conversations go well, your relationship might become something more than friendship…?

 At times, things may get a little heavy…

 Even if you make the wrong choice during conversations, don’t worry!
 Your friends (Pals) will surely forgive you, because they love you so much!
 At this academy filled with dreams and hope, meet a colorful cast of friends (Pals) and carve out an irreplaceable page of your youth!

 He…lp… me…

store.name: Wanderburg
store.short: Drive your Castle on Wheels into battle in this minimalist medieval roguelike of roaming fortresses! Devour entire villages, build your modular arsenal of siege machinery and break the game as you grow with every stronghold you crush.
store.about:
Castles weren’t built to move. Now they do. 
 Wanderburg is a fast-paced, minimalist roguelike set in a medieval world of roaming fortresses. Castles hunt, Villages flee. And only the biggest stronghold survives. What begins as a modest moving fortress quickly becomes a growing, devouring war machine that reshapes the battlefield with every run.

 Roll forward and consume everything in your path. Fleeing villages, wandering flocks and smaller fortresses all feed your growth. Defeat powerful enemy castles to push your evolution further. Your castle does not just upgrade - it expands. 
 Steam-powered siege engines roll beside arcane artillery. Knights ride bicycles into battle. Massive strongholds fire broadsides like warships on land. And somewhere beyond the hills, something bigger is already on the move.

 Build your modular arsenal piece by piece.  Break the game while you're at it. Mount cannons, raise arcane towers staffed with wizards, deploy explosives, and experiment with wildly different builds each run. Between runs, unlock new modules and vehicles that open up fresh strategies and game-breaking combinations.
 A modular progression system lets you expand your moving fortress with new siege modules and structures, while unlockable vehicles, artifacts and captains between runs steadily widen your strategic options and build variety. 

 Fully playable with mouse, keyboard, or controller and highly optimized for almost anything you throw at it.

store.name: DREADMOOR
store.short: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.
store.about:
DREADMOOR is an atmospheric first-person fishing adventure game set in a flooded world. Skill-based fishing, survival crafting, real-time combat, and exploration through rotting wetlands define your journey across land claimed by sea and decay.

 Take the helm of a fishing trawler and explore a world flooded by a catastrophic human mistake. Coastal regions have sunk beneath the water, and much of the remaining land has been submerged underwater. Travel between scattered settlements, catch fish to trade, upgrade your vessel, and craft essential equipment. Face mutated creatures across sea and land and move carefully through a divided world where resources are scarce, and trust is fragile.

 Dozens of dangerous and rare species await beneath the surface. Scour the waters for the best fishing spots, experiment with different baits, and compete with the unpredictable forces of nature as you cast your line into the murky waters. Sort your catch and keep an eye on the hold. Sea creatures do not hesitate to devour each other. The more dangerous the prey, the higher the price offered by the mysterious traders of the Submerged Lands.
 Seek out valuable resources along the way. In the Submerged Lands, scrap metal and forgotten blueprints are often worth their weight in gold. Explore abandoned buildings, caves, and shipwrecks in search of rare and useful finds.

 Resources gathered across the Submerged Lands can be crafted into specialized bait, reinforced harpoons, rare medicines, and survival tools suited to the harsh realities of this world. Discover new recipes, refine your...

store.name: Sea of Remnants
store.short: Sea of Remnants is a visually rich ocean adventure RPG. As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make.
store.about:
Legend says that beyond the moon lies another sea—a place where all questions are answered.
 When the sailor opens their eyes once more, will they see the glass bottle floating in magenta currents, or the butterfly perched on a rusted mast?
 In Sea of Remnants, you play a sailor who has lost all memory, embarking on a strange and wondrous ocean voyage alongside a mysterious girl, hoping to recover what was forgotten.
 A Ship of Stubborn Souls
 No sailor sets out without hoping to reach the Sea of Remnants.

 In this open-world journey, you'll recruit a crew of diverse puppetfolk allies, build your ship with custom parts and cannons, and assemble teams for exploration and battle. 
 Whether you act on impulse or spare your enemies, stay home or chase profit across the currents—your smallest choices ripple outward. 
 Orbtopia: A Pirate's Safe Haven
 No sailor wants to drift forever.

 Orbtopia is the liveliest pirate city on the sea. Failed voyages end here—washed back by the tide. Repair your ship, upgrade gear, and prep for the next departure.

 As night falls, sizzling oil crackles from street stalls, coin pouches jingle from another lucky trade, and someone just lost their last chip at the mahjong table. Tackleboxes snap shut with a clatter—who’s glaring green-eyed at the angler now? There, cats rule the alleys. Roosters itch to set sail. A pirate gorilla rises from obscurity. A parrot translates between beast and man. Orbtopia breathes in noise, spice, and a little chaos.
 A Reckless Voyage Awaits
 No sailor faces uncharted waters without awe.

 Unpredictable seas and...

store.name: Wyldheart
store.short: Embark on bite-sized campaigns in this co-op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world. Start from nothing, and freely build your character as you investigate rumors, explore strange ruins, and survive the dangers threatening the fallen Kingdom of Caerwyn.
store.about:
YOU ARE NOT THE CHOSEN ONE 
 Start as a humble peasant tossed into a dungeon, tasked with finding one of the ancient Relics of Caerwyn to protect your town. Choose to be a proud Freefolk, a little Mossling, a towering Grimhorn or a stout Stonefolk, with 19 backgrounds and hundreds of customisation options to choose from!
 CUSTOMIZE YOUR COMBAT STYLE 
 Quickly swap between melee and ranged weapons, casting spells, or throwing deadly concoctions during immersive, fast-paced action combat. Classless, fully flexible skill trees in Adventuring, Survival, Dungeoneering, Weaponry and the Oldways of Magic allow you to specialize or create clever combinations.

 HANG OUT IN HANDCRAFTED TOWNS 
 Meet local villagers who all have lives, stories and schedules of their own. Reveal quests by eavesdropping, deciphering rumors, and exploring strange ruins. Gather materials, craft items, cook meals for your party, and upgrade your gear before continuing your adventure!

 SCHEDULING GAME NIGHT HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER 
 Play solo, or up to 4-player co-op with seamless drop-in/drop-out. Cloud-shared saves, group XP, and scaling difficulty all mean the party can continue with someone offline, but nobody gets left behind. Designed for busy gamers, campaigns have about 10 hours of story, and 15 hours of optional content.

 LOVINGLY CRAFTED BY A SMALL INDIE TEAM 
 Wyldheart is currently in Alpha, and we’re aiming to get it ready for Early Access later this year. If you’d like to stay updated on our release, you can Wishlist now or follow us at @wyldheartgame on most social networks.

store.name: Crop
store.short: A gritty farming thriller where your safety depends on the yield. Bound to a dying farm, you must dig, plant, irrigate, and cut your way through the decay. Uncover buried secrets, both in the soil and quietly brewing within the village. The only way out is through the harvest.
store.about:
Crop pairs methodical high-stakes farming with the slow-burning dread of an investigative thriller. Constrained to a fading homestead, you must feed a village on the brink of starvation. Master the routine, or surrender to the rot.

 You didn't inherit this land - the land claimed you. Now, the farm is your reality, and how you organise it is your only remaining freedom. With a desperate town relying on your yield, you must organise your crops wisely. Dig trenches, install pumps, and repair crumbling equipment to squeeze every drop of life from the dirt.

 The small town is severed from the world, and its survival rests in your unprepared hands. The odds are stacked against you: the farm is in a state of decay, choked by the clutter of the previous owner. Cut through waist-high grass to prevent pests, produce compost to improve the quality of crops, and meticulously prepare your plots. Whether you’re wearing a raincoat to endure a punishing storm or placing scarecrows against flocks of birds, every ditch dug and pesticide sprayed is a choice. The work is heavy, but in a world this broken, only tireless effort will move you forward.

 Your duties don't end at digging dirt. Why were you brought here? Why is the town cut off from the world? And who is watching from the shadows as dusk falls? Investigation is as vital as irrigation. Balance the toil of the fields with the hunt for answers. Every crop you harvest might buy the townsfolk another day of life, but every secret you unearth brings you closer to the truth.

 Navigate the stillness of the fields as the sun sets, and...

store.name: Frostpunk: 1886
store.short: A full reimagining of Frostpunk, the groundbreaking survival city builder, packed with new content. In a world ravaged by endless frost, become the Captain of the last city on Earth. Manage its people and infrastructure while facing cruel weather and even crueler choices.
store.about:
Frostpunk 1886 introduces new content and visuals while staying true to the legacy of the original Frostpunk, sticking to its premise and unique gameplay feel.
 Features:
 A completely new Purpose Path (in addition to Faith and Order)

 New explorable areas promising unique discoveries and hidden stories from the Frostlands

 New events, mechanics, laws, technologies, and buildings

 Full mod support

 Close-up view of your citizens paired with wider views of the city

 Several QoL features

 See New London with new eyes. Play through the original Frostpunk scenarios in fresh new ways, thanks to the wealth of additional content. You’ll face new challenges, employ different strategies, and discover unexpected truths about the world of Frostpunk… and yourself.
 Witness your people’s personal stories in unprecedented detail by bringing the camera closer to the struggle. In Frostpunk 1886, the experience is more intimate and immersive than ever before.
 With the game being rebuilt in a new engine, mods are finally coming to further extend and customize your playthroughs. It’s the perfect platform for all the wild mods, stories, and moral quandaries that the Frostpunk community is already eager to unleash.

 As Captain, you must protect humanity’s last bastion by managing a community built around the Generator, the city's only source of life-saving heat. Establish laws that regulate the existence of your growing society. Decide on their working routine, free time, food provision, and other crucial aspects of everyday life. Optimization and resource management must often clash...

store.name: GONE Fishing
store.short: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?
store.about:
Cast your line to feed an ancient eldritch beast. Bring friends or go solo. It doesn’t care who is feeding it, only that it is fed. With over 100 different species of creatures to catch and dozens of live animals to use as bait.

 Grill it, smoke it, turn it into a pearl, or bet it all in the gambling pit. Sell the extra fish you catch and spend the profits on upgrades, better gear, and items from the traders found around the map.

 You must sacrifice a certain amount of fish to the beast every day if you want to survive, but the beast is not the only thing out there. Be wary of territorial beasts, stalking nightmares, and ambushing predators. Learn the creatures of the land to avoid being killed, you can't feed the hungering abomination if you are dead...

 Drink beer, explore multiple maps, customize your characters, play instruments, catch fish and legendary creatures like the Lochness monster, explode monsters (and people), AND GAMBLE.

 Fight back against the Lake Entity and stop the beast!

store.name: Sombie
store.short: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.
store.about:
Meet new friends, or don't... 
 This game is always online. We recommend befriending other players along the way to survive together. If you would rather shoot them and take their loot for yourself, you have that option. 
 Loot 
 In towns you can enter houses and find food, weapons, and ammo.

 Build a camp 
 Cut down trees, gather materials, and build a home to call your own.

 Vehicles 
 Cars are an excellent weapon, and transportation, but be careful, cars may break and need repair

 Fishing 
 Tired of the constant action? go do something more relaxing. Go fishing, fish is a good source of food, or you can sell it to merchants in order to buy what you want.

 Fight off the hoard 
 Hoards of zombies will chase you if you get near, or make too much noise. You can fight them off with weapons, but beware, shooting brings attention from both players and sombies.

 Current Features
 Infinite world 
The world is generated as you, or others explore. There is no edge to the universe of Sombie.

 PvP / PvE 
Hoards of zombies will chase you if you get near, or make too much noise. You can fight them off with weapons, but beware, shooting brings attention from both players and sombies.

 L oot
In towns you can enter houses and find food, weapons, and ammo.

 Chat 
There is both global and local chat. Global broadcasts your message to the entire server. Local lets you communicate only with nearby players.

 Voice chat There is local voice chat, if you are near  another player and you have a microphone you can speak to them.

 And many more things to come...

store.name: Armatus
store.short: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.
store.about:
ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.
 HUMANITY’S TIME IS OVER
 The world has ended. Demons overrun once busy streets as reality unravels. Collapse is inevitable. Sequestered behind holy wards, the last survivors believe themselves the only humans left alive. Their only hope is for you to carve a path through the chaos and find their salvation. But the broken pieces of Paris give way to increasingly demonic hellscapes inhabited by ever stronger and more grotesque monsters.

 FIGHT. DIE. REPEAT.
 Knowledge is a weapon, and death is never the end. Each run, wield your scythe and a gun of your choosing against brutal demons hellbent on your destruction. To overcome them, evolve your combat style with powerful celestial abilities and passive enhancements. Die and you will revive to fight again. 
 Fight, die, revive, and try again; Push forward to get farther each run and master your arsenal.

 START STRONG, END GODLY
 From the moment you step into the ruins, you are heavily armed and powerful. Yet you will keep gaining new powers until you have the tools to lay waste to your enemies. Find your favorite lethal combination of guns and powers, from SMGs and shotguns to holy fire and slow time, to truly obliterate everything standing in your way.
 Will you grow strong enough to defeat the horrors of the Scoured Path?

store.name: Guildrun
store.short: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.
store.about:
Rifts have torn open in cities across the world, and no one knows what's driving them. You are tasked with building a guild of unique heroes, level them up to crazy power spikes and combine their abilities with items and relics to break the game and unveil the unknown cause of the rift crisis.

 Adapt each run as different things are offered to you. With infinite build freedom without a PvP meta that would force certain strategies, every run feels like a new puzzle. As you learn the depth of options available you’ll become an expert at pivoting mid-run, reshaping any makeshift team into an unstoppable force.

 Every hero has their starting class and ability, but you choose where they end. With over 500 unique ways to level up and shape each hero, get creative and turn a backline healer into a frontline tank or a ranged dps into a melee brawler. Or, pair two lovers on the battlefield for rapid scaling bonuses.

 Unlock Heroes, items and relics.  Run-by-run, unlock new heroes, relics and items to discover 25 heroes, 180 specializations, 300+ relics and 100+ items in the demo alone.

 Play on your clock . No timer, no queue, no PvP. Think as long as you want, save mid-run, and come back when life lets you.

 Break every hero out of their class . 25 heroes across 75 spec paths, and a modifier pool that stacks across classes. Draft, level, respec, and build unfair comps.

 Progress through 8 difficulties . Every successful run unlocks a harder challenge for the next. Stack fresh modifiers to climb up the difficulty ladder, then hit Endless mode to chase the top of the global...

store.name: Warhammer Survivors
store.short: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.
store.about:
The addictive bullet-heaven action of the survivors genre comes to the 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms in an officially licensed game from Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors). 

Experience Warhammer’s epic champions, enemies, weapons and more, meticulously handcrafted in animated pixel glory. 

 - Frenetic Bullet Heaven survival in a grim dark setting 
- Over 40 iconic playable characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes, featuring Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun’s very own Malum Caedo! 
- Multiple modes and stages from across the grim, dark 41st Millennium and the Mortal Realms.  
- An arsenal of 75+ weapons, such as the Boltgun, Astartes Chainsword, Whirlwind Axes and easter eggs such as the humble pot of Nuln Oil.  
- Face down the mightiest monsters the universes have to offer, including the disgustingly bloated Great Unclean One. Extremis Bosses pose a challenge even for Survivors-like veterans! 
- A mighty cache of passives and power-ups to aid in enduring against the monstrous legions.  
- Esoteric secrets to uncover and collectables to collect!  
- ...and more! 

 Choose your universe and become a legend of the Imperium or champion of Order in frenetic battles across the open and ashen plains of Aqshy to the tight and confined corridors of an abandoned Space Hulk. Every stage is a new arena of slaughter, each with its own enemy faction... and secrets to uncover. 

 Unlock and choose from over 40 of your favorite characters from both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer...

store.name: CONTROL Resonant
store.short: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.
store.about:
After years in confinement at the hands of the Federal Bureau of Control (FBC), Dylan Faden emerges into a warped Manhattan at the peak of a paranatural crisis. 

 Charged with combating a mysterious cosmic entity as it alters fundamental aspects of our reality, Dylan must harness his new-found powers to take the fight to the myriad threats overwhelming Manhattan. 

 Join Dylan in this sequel to the multi-award-winning CONTROL to explore the expansive zones of a city overrun by the corrupting influences of the chaotic Hiss, invasive micro-organism, the Mold, and other twisted paranatural threats. 

 On the path to unlocking the full potential of his paranatural abilities Dylan will also seek out his sister, FBC Director Jesse Faden, as he bids to comprehend and contain the dangers that have spilled beyond the confines of the Oldest House to tear our world apart. 
 STEP INTO A WARPED REALITY    
 Explore multiple areas of a ravaged Manhattan in an expansive, unfamiliar, and exciting world.  

Traverse perception-bending locations and grapple with gravity anomalies that distort the vertical and horizontal plane, adding additional dimensions to puzzles and new tactical decisions to combat.  

Meet faces old and new on a path fraught with risk but rich in opportunity as the cityscape is reshaped and reality is redefined by a godlike force.

 MASTER THE PARANATURAL  
 Channel the raw experiences of Dylan’s past to help understand his present and dig deeper into the inner workings of the FBC and reveal the horrors threatening humankind. 

Tap into power he must learn to master...

store.name: HABROMANIA
store.short: A dreamy Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact.
store.about:
Alice must have been falling for at least an hour. Or maybe longer- Alice has never been very good at keeping time. But the wind rushes in her hair, yanking at her clothes, and it's almost like she's flying. It's glorious. 
 Until she hits the ground. 

 HABROMANIA is a dreamy (or nightmarish) Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact. Alice wakes up at the bottom of a hole with a pounding headache and no memories of how she landed there- or memories in general, actually. 

 She can't remember her past, but she knows that she needs to get out of here, wherever here is. Guide Alice as she attempts to escape Wonderland, navigating lush, hand-drawn environments and the socially incompetent characters who inhabit them, all with their own complex pasts and varied moral compasses.

 Explore  immersive, maximalist environments jam-packed with interactables and collectibles, accompanied by an original OST played on an out-of-tune piano

 Make Choices through branching dialogue and a karma system that determines the fate of the creatures of Wonderland and Alice herself,

 Collect Very Interesting And Useful things  that aid in puzzle-solving, bartering, and uncovering the deeper lore of Wonderland and the people there

 Uncover the past  and the truth about Wonderland before Alice loses her head (or her mind)

 HABROMANIA is a narrative-driven game with 12 "chapters" and multiple endings. Chapters will be released continuously with game updates. 

 and...

store.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
store.short: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!
store.about:
《TBH: Task Bar Hero》   is the ultimate tiny idle RPG that fits right into your taskbar. 
 Just leave it running on your screen — your pixel heroes will automatically gather loot and grow stronger on their own.
 Explore diverse regions, level up your characters and gear, build your own strategies, and take down waves of monsters!

 ■ Small But Mighty RPG 
 - A full hack-and-slash RPG experience packed into a tiny window.
 - Mix and match classes, items, and skills to craft your own unique build.
 - Use the Cube System to add and customize stats on your items.
 - 3 Acts and 4 difficulty tiers, each filled with a variety of monsters to defeat.

 ■ Play Anytime — Even During Work 
 - Your adventure keeps going automatically, even when you're away.
 - Simple controls make it easy to pick up and play for as long as you like.
 - Lightweight design lets it run comfortably alongside other programs.

 ■  Key Features 
 - 500+ unique items
 - 50+ monster types
 - 50+ unlockable achievements
 - Items freely tradeable on the Steam Market
 - A loot system with rarities ranging from Common, Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary, all the way up to Immortal, Arcana, Beyond, Celestial, Divine, and Cosmic

store.name: Mortuus
store.short: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.
store.about:
Mortuus is a round-based zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive the round, spend your points, choose your upgrade and last as long as you can. The rules are familar but the map is not. 
Every run builds a new procedurally generated map, so the doors, the perk machines, the mystery box and the way out are never where they were last time. Play solo or with friends

 No run starts on a layout you have memorized. Rooms, corridors, courtyards and dead ends are rebuilt each time, in daylight or at night, in clear weather or a storm. You learn the game, not the map.
 Buy doors and clear debris to open the map, and find the power switch. Hit the mystery box or take a gun off the wall. Buy perks from machines scattered across the map. Feed your gun to the Gun Ascension altar and choose how it gets stronger, as many times as you can afford. After every round, pick one upgrade from a draft and build something different each run.

 Arms and legs come off where you shoot them. Shoot the legs and they crawl. Big guns punch holes straight through. Bodies fall the way the bullet sent them, then bleed out, burn up or shatter depending on how they died.
 From the early rounds some zombies chase you, some cut you off and some go around. Later they are joined by worse things: the Juggernaut, Skitter and more which charges through its own horde to grab you, the Lope, which runs on its arms, and the Skitter, which comes across the ceiling.

 Key features
 Round-based survival 

 Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players

 A new map every run 

 Over 30 guns 

 Perks, Gun Ascension and an...

store.name: DUMMY HOUSE
store.short: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.
store.about:
You are trapped inside a sealed industrial complex, with no human contact, and must survive the “Experiment Nights”. The dark corridors are inhabited by entities known as "Dummy" — imperfect copies of human beings that have learned to imitate our gestures, voices, and expressions.

 The only tool at your disposal is a camera. Use sound to guide yourself, track the "Dummy" subjects in the dark and photograph them to repel their approach. As you hear footsteps and voices getting closer and closer. Your mind and reflexes will be constantly put to the test.

 Simply hiding is not enough — each night demands strategy and quick decisions. Survive multiple enemies at the same time while trying to find a way out through the computer terminal.

 With multiple different endings, the game’s universe is shrouded in mysteries that connect according to your gameplay style. It is up to you to piece together the investigation and discover how far this story goes and what your role is in all of this.
 Main Features 
 📸 Innovative mechanic: Use sound as guidance and the camera to drive enemies away.
 🧩 Strategic survival: Manage every decision and every photograph, knowing that one mistake can be fatal . 
 🎧 Immersive atmosphere: Complete darkness, 3D audio, and a reactive environment with tension increasing every night.
 👁️ Intense psychological horror — Face enemies that imitate humans, causing constant discomfort.
 🔀 Multiple endings — Different outcomes reveal hidden layers of the story and the game’s universe.
 ♻️ High replayability — Customizable stages, every attempt brings new...

store.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
store.short: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!
store.about:
🕹️ Welcome to Replay Value – the ultimate second-hand game store sim! 
Start from scratch and build your dream retro game shop in this quirky and satisfying job simulator. Buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, and turn forgotten discs into hot-shelf hits. 

Whether you're restoring a dusty classic or haggling over a rare gem, your goal is simple: make profit, grow your inventory, and create a store worthy of the name Replay Value . 🛒 Features

 🎮 Buy, Sell, Haggle 
Deal with random customer requests every day; some want to sell their collection, others are after something specific. Negotiate prices, make counter-offers, and decide when to walk away.

 🧼 Restore & Reuse 
Fix up old games through interactive mini-games like CD cleaning, box repair, tag removal, and disk checks. Presentation matters, clean games sell better!

 📦 Manage Your Store 
Physically place games on your shop shelves, tag them with prices, and decide what to display. Want to sell something online instead? Use the digital storefront and check for end-of-day sales.

 📈 Upgrade & Expand 
Invest your earnings to unlock new platforms like consoles and handhelds, buy extra shelves, and decorate your store with posters, stickers, and figures. Even run ads to bring in more customers!

 📊 Daily Summary 
Track your profits, sold inventory, and missed opportunities with a handy end-of-day report, inspired by classic sim games.

 📅 Infinite Replayability 
With randomized customers, negotiation quirks, and hundreds of games to collect, every day is a fresh challenge. Can you master the...

store.name: Project Android
store.short: Project Android, the solution to tomorrow's problems. Perform various experiments and raise the android Femme into humanity's savior.
store.about:
A visual novel-type game centered around performing various experiments with the android "Femme".
 Story
 This completely emotionless android will develop according to the researchers you assign to her. What will her AI learn, and how will it use this knowledge to save humanity?

All of this depends on you. 
 Gameplay & Features
 This is an important step towards humanity's future. 
 Make your hypotheses and perform experiments.

Your allotted training period is 30 days. 
 In other words, you have 30 tries to develop Femme into the ideal android.
 Characters

 Name: Femme Fatale
 Occupation: Android (Prototype)
 Age: Newly built
 Characteristics: Emotionless
 Personality: Under construction

store.name: President Simulator
store.short: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.
store.about:
Welcome to the Oval Office. Settle in, put your feet on the desk, and get ready to ruin the country... or save it by accident. 
 In this satirical political simulator, competence is optional, but chaos is guaranteed. You have the power, the pen, and above all, the Big Red Button. What could possibly go wrong?
 On your agenda: 
 Extreme Legislator: Sign, stamp, or bin totally wacky decrees. Legalize socks with sandals? Why not. Consequences are a problem for later.

 Crisis Management by Guesswork: You don't need to actually understand an issue to manage it. 

 Double-Speak 2.0: Shine during press conferences. When a journalist asks "Why?", answer with an inspiring speech that means absolutely nothing.

 Total Tactile Immersion: It's your office. Throw decrees, shove your advisors. You are the President, nobody’s going to stop you.

 The Red Button: It’s there. It’s glowing. It’s tempting. Press it. Go on. Just to see what happens.

 From Ruins to Glory: Cracked walls, cobwebs, planks on the windows... your predecessor left quite a mess. Clean it up and restore the Oval Office to its former glory. You've earned it.

 Cabinet of "Yes-Men": Recruit advisors who will execute your most absurd decisions. They are here to serve, not to think.

 Political Roulette: Watch your actions succeed (or fail miserably). Politics is just like a casino, after all.

 The Art of Balance (or lack thereof): Going all-in on the military won't save you when the economy collapses. Try to juggle, or face the consequences.

 Gotcha Interviews: Journalists have memories like elephants. They will...

store.name: Darkwood 2
store.short: Roam freely around the scorched deserts of a dying sea as you secure resources and explore the mysteries of Darkwood. But beware nightfall – seek shelter, shore up your defenses, and pray for the morning light as the horrors of the world hunt the ill-prepared.
store.about:
Set merely a few years after the events of the critically acclaimed survival horror game Darkwood, the sequel brings with it new lands and waters to explore, new creatures to fear, and new reasons to pray for the morning light. Featuring an entirely new story and new characters, the unfolding events of Darkwood 2 stand on their own, and can be equally enjoyed regardless of whether you’ve played the first game in the series.

 In the aftermath of the Soviet Union's collapse, the dying Aral Sea has become the site of an anomaly – an eerie forest that swallows everything in its path. No one knows where it came from, or why – retribution, perhaps, for humanity’s abuse of nature.

 All around lie the ruins of a vanished world – deserted villages, rusting ships marooned in sand, derelict oil rigs, power stations, and factories on the verge of collapse. A secret biological lab sits in silence on a remote island as roving gangs of looters, bikers, and former soldiers control the remaining population through fear. Nomads travel through these lands with no rest or respite, day or night – even walls can't guarantee safety. 

 As the world loses its humanity, and as the so-called corruption of the forest spreads, one can't help but wonder – is it really better to remain human? Or would it be best to give in?

 Only the heart of the forest holds the answer.

 Darkwood 2 sends you on dangerous meandering paths across barren deserts, through thick marsh, and on deep waters alike. As the locals fight to keep the slowly spreading woods at bay, you must rely on your wits to overcome your...

store.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
store.short: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.
store.about:
STEP INTO A WORLD CREATED BY ALCHEMY 
 Master Fulcanelli's forbidden spell has thrown the magical world out of balance. Now the First Tree, creator of all living things, calls upon new alchemists to undo his mistake.
 BREW POTIONS AND OUTRACE YOUR RIVALS 
 Gather ingredients, brew Potions, and combine them into increasingly complex Recipes. Use your opponents' Recipes, cast Spells, and wield Talismans — and be the first to reach three Places of Power to save the magical world from destruction.
 EXPERIENCE A BOARD GAME CLASSIC IN A NEW WAY 
 Potion-making is a digital adaptation of the beloved board game that has sold over 300,000 copies in the past 20 years. Compete against AI opponents or play online with friends.
 HOW TO PLAY 
 Each turn consists of four phases: Sorcery, Creating, Travelling, and Replenishment .
 Sorcery 
 Cast Spells and use Talismans to gain extra actions, ingredients, and Potions — or instantly change the situation on the board.

 Creating 
 Complete Recipes using ingredients and finished Potions — your own or your opponents'. The more complex the Recipe, the more powerful the Power Token you receive.

 Travelling 
 Use your Power Tokens to move across the Travel Board. Reach three Places of Power before your opponents to win.

 Replenishment 
 Draw new cards and prepare for your next turn. Choose between Recipes of varying difficulty and plan your next combination.

 The fate of this world is in your hands. Don't let it disappear!
 EXPLORE THE WORLD 
 Play across different corners of the magical world, where new obstacles and challenges await....

store.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
store.short: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.
store.about:
Embrace the role of an Inquisitor in the grim darkness of the far future in a cRPG set in the rich Warhammer 40,000 universe. Start your service as an acolyte of the Inquisition: Investigate heresy, command a diverse warband, and shape the fate of the Calixis Sector in a story-rich experience where every decision has weight, justice is non-existent, and the line between salvation and damnation is razor-thin. Explore an in-depth depiction of the Inquisition as an organisation and the vast force it commands: its power, bureaucracy, and inner conflicts laid bare like never before. 
 As an Inquisitor, you have one primary goal: to protect the Imperium, whether that be from the taint of xenos, the betrayal of heretics, or the scourge of mutants, by any means necessary. Be the conduit of the Emperor’s will in a place where all hope was lost decades ago, explore the mysteries of the maddening Tyrant Star, and overcome the worst horrors thrown at you by the Noctis Aeterna.

 Your duty is to investigate heresy deep within the Calixis Sector. Your craft is to expose the hidden rot in places where no one else dares to look, to be the final defense of Humanity in the face of annihilation. Uncover nefarious plots, interrogate suspects, and piece together conspiracies in a deep investigative system. The only question is, how far are you willing to go on the path of damnation in the name of salvation?

 Every Inquisitorial warband is unique, and yours is no exception. Ranging from loyal Imperial subjects, such as a veteran Guardsman from the death world of Catachan, to nefarious xenos,...

store.name: Funnel Runners
store.short: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.
store.about:
Welcome to Funnel Runners , where you will have your first on-site deployment with APEX Storm Monitoring Services. 

A high-priority F5 tornado is approaching, and we are counting on you (and up to 7 fellow friends) to collect data, scavenge necessary information , and, of course, survive .

 The weather is your worst enemy here. Tornados and storms will spawn randomly , grow stronger over time, and tear the whole map apart . Buildings will collapse piece by piece, and items will no longer be found in destroyed areas, so you must adapt quickly.   Be careful not to be swept up by the wind; you may not be found again. 

 In this mission, you can team up with 7 other players or tackle it solo . Share gadgets, split up to cover more ground, collect necessary information and items to fix the van before the situation turns bad. 

With realistic graphics and a first-person perspective , the experience brings you close to every gust of wind, distant siren, and falling piece of debris.

 Scavenge the collapsing city for scattered vehicle parts, fuel, and tools . These items will allow you to repair your van and help you survive the storm . Each playthrough features randomized environments, weather, items, and problems to solve on your vehicle . No playthrough will be the same.

store.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
store.short: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.
store.about:
Your glorious collection has been forgotten, now it's time to restore to it to its true form. Pick each card, inspect them, clean them and store them in their own cabinets. Each card has a thematical set, archetype and rarity; there are even foil cards! Watch and relax as all the chaos slowly turns into an orderly gallery. 

 Luckily not every card got dirty, but there are definitely some filthy ones. Take them to your cleaning table and watch as the dusty card transitions into a smooth, shiny and beautiful piece.

 Collecting and cleaning your cards isn't enough, you have to put them into their own place. Put the cards into their right set cabinets, archetype cabinets and holders. Carefully inspect each card and determine where they belong!

 Key Features
 A relaxing and stress free gameplay loop with no timers or penalties.

 Satisfying ASMR card cleaning.

 Cozy first-person tidying, sorting, cleaning gameplay.

 Four-hundred unique cards to discover and display.

 A graceful transformation of chaos and order.

store.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
store.short: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

store.name: Shift At Midnight
store.short: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.
store.about:
Managing a gas station is tough work, keep your stock shelves full and sell enough products to meet your quota each night, take deliveries and keep your store nice and clean.
 Oh, and make sure to interrogate each customer as you serve - as some are not human and are in fact doppelgangers – miss one and they will return later that shift to try and kill you and your friends… Execute on site if you think they are not human – just be sure to clean up after.
 If you mess up, be prepared to set traps, barricade the doors and hide as the doppelgangers return as horrible monsters.
 Manage your gas station 
 Stock the shelves, take deliveries, keep your store clean & serve customers. Each shift is randomly generated… meaning no 2 shifts are the same.

 Not all customers are human… 
 Managing a gas station these days also means you have to be a detective… examine their ID, cross-check their details in the computer, and observe their behaviour. Make sure they are human before you let them leave, or they will come back…

 Board Up, Lay Traps and Hide 
 If a creature manages to leave the store, all hell breaks loose. Barricade the doors, place traps, and find a place to hide. Survival is no longer guaranteed.

 Better with friends! 
 Multiplayer is where the game thrives, work together or at least be together… proximity chat enhances the experience.

 Features: 
 Multiplayer

 Proximity chat

 Interrogate customers

 Story Mode with 13 Randomly Generated Shifts

 Gas Station Management

 Character customisation

 Endless Mode (BETA): 
 A free, major ENDLESS MODE update is planned for...

store.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
store.short: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day - while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?
store.about:
When Chris David unexpectedly inherits a dilapidated English hotel, he has exactly 30 days and 30 nights to restore the crumbling edifice before it… or something else… claims HIM. 
 Nothing is as it seems in the Grand Hotel, lurking beneath the veneer of paper and paint he applies during the day, something horrible shivers and slithers during the night. Don’t believe them when they tell you that There Are No Ghosts at the Grand . 

 While the daylight lasts, restore the hotel’s faded grandeur by wielding friendly, talking power tools, a sandblaster, paint sprayer, furniture cannon, and daisy-chain gun. When night falls, however, those same tools transform into weapons against the supernatural. Unleash the vacuum on vengeful spirits, expose invisible assailants with the paint sprayer, or subdue slithering spooks with a well-aimed bookcase to the face using the furniture cannon. 

 It's not just the hotel that needs help. Explore the surrounding village to find buildings in need of renovation, and maybe discover a few secrets along the way. You’ll shoot paint and paper onto the walls of the old fish and chip shop, blow out broken windows at the florist, and smash old furniture in the bookshop. At other times, you’ll need to slow down to consider light environmental puzzles, using the hotel’s dark past to unravel cryptic clues. 

 At the heart of the game lies a rich, supernatural mystery – one that winds through the Grand Hotel’s storied history, its former owners, and the player’s own buried past. The hotel and its surrounding village hold more than meets the eye, with...

store.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
store.short: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!
store.about:
Your very own barn  

 You’ve finally saved up the money to get a plot of land with a run-down shack of a stable – It’s not much but it’s yours. Time for you and your trusted mare to start training, so you can participate in tournaments in the nearby town and grow your ramshackle yard into the stud farm of your dreams!
 Take Care of your Horse(s) 

 Groom and comb your horses in crisp, satisfying care interactions that are grounded in realism without being tedious. Use your brush and hoofpick to avoid saddle sores and abscesses, and treat scrapes and injuries appropriately when they happen. 
 Train, Compete, Explore 

 Complete training exercises and build up your horse’s strength and confidence to qualify for competitions and earn prize money in show jumping and cross country. Take your horses out on trail rides for a change of pace and scenery – Whether it's in the forest, along the beach or through the mountains, you get to enjoy beautiful vistas and you never know what you might find along the way!
 Breed & Evolve 

 Breed adorable foals to improve your stock over time. Foals will inherit a mix of their parents' coloring, white patterns and even personality traits. Carefully plan your stallion and mare pairings to bring out the best in your offspring, whether you’re going for looks or stats.
 Upgrade & Manage  

 Save up for upgrading your buildings to make space for more horses and better meeting their needs. Hire staff to stay on top of care and training for a growing herd. Advanced building stages will unlock new training courses, staff applications and a high tech...

store.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
store.short: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.
store.about:
By the 24th century, humanity has conquered the cosmos. However, life has remained anything but easy. In The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, a story-driven sci-fi Action RPG, you play as a Pinkwater Security mercenary whose brief shore leave on the asteroid Eros spirals out of control. Trapped in a deadly lockdown and drawn into a solar system-wide conspiracy far beyond your control, you’ll have to adapt, survive, taking command of the most advanced ship in the whole of the solar system.
 Create and customize your own captain — Earther, Martian, or Belter — and lead a crew of highly-skilled specialists as you face off against escalating threats, political pressure, and a relentless enemy that will stop at nothing to see you dead. In a solar system held together by fragile alliances, every decision leaves its mark. 

 Your companions are more than just mission assets — they are people with their own scars and loyalties. Some chase redemption. Others hide their truths. Over time, your relationships will flourish or deteriorate depending on the choices you make and how you choose to lead. The ship becomes your home — a place where trust is earned, not given.

 Fight in third-person utilizing cover-focused gunplay and abilities. Two companions will accompany you into the field while others will support from a distance: disabling systems or drawing the enemies’ attention. You will issue real-time commands and have to adapt quickly to survive the manifold threats the system will throw at you.

 Visit iconic locations like Ganymede, Ceres, Mars, and Luna. Walk through ruined habitats and...

store.name: Kaiju Cleanup
store.short: Relax and unwind by cleaning up the world’s biggest corpses either solo or co-op. In a Cleaning Sim like no other, your job is to slice up and tidy away Kaiju carcasses, leaving the city clean and serene. Until the next Kaiju attack, obviously.
store.about:
When colossal alien titans run rampant until getting domed by a railgun, the world finds itself in need of a true hero. That’s you: a Kaiju Cleaner who won’t be perturbed by petty concerns like “workplace injury” or “life expectancy”.

 After another bastard Kaiju attacks another crowded city, you must use your tools to clean up vast piles of dead monster until the zone is safe for reconstruction. The Kaiju may be dead, but its corpse is leaking radiation, seeping acidic fluids, concealing explosive organs, and generally making the area inhospitable to any other form of life. You’ll probably die as you go about your work, but that’s fine; send another clone, mop up your corpse, and carry on.

 When dealing with Kaiju this big, the detritus warrants calling in a team. Up to 4 cleaners can tackle the monstrous mess left behind via online co-op.

 Enjoy therapeutic tasks with your own methodology and a selection of helpful tools. Work at your own pace; that giant corpse isn’t going anywhere. Extract and launch Kaiju innards with a meat-wrenching claw, slice them into manageable chunks, slurp up its various jellies, and power-wash detritus until the hazard zone is sparkling clean.

 Turn KaijuCorp from a scrappy band of outcasts and delinquents into Earth’s best Kaiju Cleanup firm either solo or as part of a team of up to four reprobates. Complete missions to upgrade your equipment and customize your base, van, and outfit.

 Explore environments the Kaiju have rudely died in and figure out what they have against skyscrapers anyway. Pick apart audio logs, chat with your crew,...

copies.name: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals

store.name: Guns of Eschaton
store.short: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!
store.about:
The Old South is burning, but its legends are not quite (un)dead.
 Guns of Eschaton is a first-person soulslike shooter set in an apocalyptic Western by legendary art director Viktor Antonov (Half-Life 2, Dishonored, Prey, Fallout 4, Wolfenstein: The New Order). It is a land of dust, blood, false saints, broken history, and occult horror—a wasteland where the road to salvation is narrow and paved with spent shells and bodies that remember your name.

 You are almost ordinary: fragile, outmatched, and surrounded by a dying world full of monsters.
 However, you have everything you need to survive the horrors of the burning world: a Colt, the instincts of a killer, and the will to make it home, no matter how long the road becomes.
 This is not a fast-paced shooter where victory comes from reflexes alone. Every bullet matters. Every gun has its own character. Every monster has a weakness. 
 You cannot rely on old shooter instincts—you will have to learn how to shoot all over again.
 Study your enemies. Identify their weaknesses. Commit to every action with intent. Surviving this frontier takes more than just a steady aim: adapt your tactics with different bullet types, calculated parries and dashes, mystic abilities granted through occult means, and anything else you can find to keep yourself alive.
 And when the road becomes too arduous to walk alone—call your posse.

 This is a personal journey through a world-scale catastrophe.
 You are a man who has lost almost everything, trying to return home before the last scraps are taken from him. The road ahead runs across the Old...

store.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
store.short: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.
store.about:
Most people resort to therapy. But you chose the brave option. A sledgehammer. 

In Virtue and a Sledgehammer, explore the remains of your hometown haunted by the android ghosts of your digitized neighbors. There won't always be a clear path, so create your own by knocking down any structures that stand in your way. 

It will be a painful journey, not only because of the assault from the robots that have taken over life in the mountains, but because of the memories you’ll unearth—sometimes warm, but often traumatic—as you destroy the remnants of your childhood.

A game about family, traditions, and being a misfit.

 Wield your sledgehammer like an instrument of reckoning, swinging through the swathes of mechanical human facsimiles and the buildings they call home. But will violent catharsis salve your soul, or make the pain burn brighter? 

 You can’t tear down the place you were born without awakening a few ghosts. The cinematic sequences of interactive fiction will reveal your fears, desires, and your family’s knotty web of virtues and flaws.

 Flesh is a source of aches and tainted humors. 
 It's only now, devoid of bones, devoid of hunger, that I can tell you...
 I have never been happier.

store.name: Danganronpa 2x2
store.short: While on a school trip to Jabberwock Island, students are ensnared in Monokuma’s deadly game, forced into mutual killing and Class Trials to expose the culprit. Break through contradictions with high-speed detective action. Includes both a brand-new scenario and the enhanced original!
store.about:
Jabberwock Island—once a bustling tourist hotspot, now an uninhabited island that remains strangely well-kept.
 You and your classmates from Hope’s Peak Academy visit this island for a school trip, but the pleasant getaway is short-lived. Monokuma’s scheme forces everyone into yet another deadly game. As the curtain rises on a new cycle of mutual killing, the only path to escape lies in uncovering the island’s secrets.
 But remember: what awaits at the end of the truth is not always hope...
 <Game Overview>
 Investigate murders by gathering testimonies and evidence, then identify the "Blackened" during the Class Trial. Debate with your classmates in high-speed detective action as you shoot through contradictions using Truth Bullets. Trials feature voice acting by a celebrated cast.
 Each case is divided into three primary parts:
 ■ Daily Life
 Explore Jabberwock Island freely and interact with the Ultimate Students. When a murder occurs and a body is discovered, the game transitions into the Investigation phase.
 ■ Investigation
 Examine crime scenes, interview other students, and collect the evidence needed to crack the case. The clues you find become Truth Bullets used to refute contradictory statements. Once all evidence is gathered, the Class Trial begins.
 ■ Class Trial
 Use the evidence you’ve collected to expose the "Blackened". Students debate the case from various angles, and their statements flow across the screen in real time. Fire the appropriate Truth Bullets to break through contradictions and advance the debate. Unravel the case’s truth in nonstop,...

store.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
store.short: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.
store.about:
14th-century Europe. Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the Black Death comes for the survivors. It's a moment of weakness - and that's all they needed. Vampires seize their opportunity to walk out of the shadows and claim what they've been denied for centuries: freedom, and the power that comes with it. Other creatures of the night follow their lead. Legends turn into reality, and history as we know it will never be the same.
 You play as Coen, a young man turned into a Dawnwalker, forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night. Fight for your humanity or embrace the cursed powers to save your family. Whatever your choice, the question stands: is your soul worth the lives of those you love?

 Experience and shape the plot the way you want. Embark on the quest to save your family, or swear revenge on your sire and destroy everyone standing in your way. Discover ancient secrets lurking in the valley. Rush in head first or risk taking time to prepare. Go alone or search for friends and forge unlikely alliances.

 Experience two different gameplay loops, offering distinct abilities to choose from, mysteries to uncover, and varying ways to achieve your goals. Experiment with different approaches and discover how the world reacts to your actions.

 Every action - and inaction - shapes the world around you. Your family’s days are numbered, and every time you take on a quest, time moves forward, compelling you closer to the end. Choose carefully whom to help and whom to leave behind. You will not have time for everyone. The world waits for no one....

store.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
store.short: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.
store.about:
Strike fear in your foes as you board and sink enemy vessels as Edward Kenway, captain of the Jackdaw. Whether blending into crowds or leading daring assaults, switch between silent takedowns and fierce brawls as you effortlessly wield swords, pistols, and the Hidden Blade. With a cast of historical pirate legends at your side, defy empires amidst the age-old conflict opposing Assassins and Templars.

store.short: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, it’s just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.
store.about:
Wild n Chill’s a cozy wilderness survival game for folks who’d rather build a cabin than fight over one, solo or with a few good pals by your side. From the makers of Cast n Chill, this time you step onto land to hunt, fish, trap, gather and craft your way through the wild - all while keepin’ your belly full, your firewood dry, and the wolves outta camp.
 Whether you’re throwin’ together a leaky little lean-to or buildin’ the finest dang cabin this side o’ Blackbear Hollow, life out here moves at your pace.
 Survive the Wild
 Keep an eye on your food, water, and energy while livin’ off the land. Catch fish, gather berries, chop wood, set traps, and hunt for supper while the wilderness tries its best to keep ya humble.
 Most critters’ll leave ya be... but bears and wolves ain’t exactly known for their manners. 
 Meet the Locals
 There’s a couple strange ol’ hermits livin’ deep in the wilderness. Friendly enough... once they stop starin’ at ya.
 Bring ‘em the right supplies and they might just trade ya somethin’ special.

 Play Solo or With Ya Pals

 Start with nothin’ but cold hands and bad ideas, then slowly turn the wilderness into home sweet home.

store.name: About Fishing
store.short: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.
store.about:
About Fishing is a fishing mystery game that blends the calm, meditative rhythm of fishing with the quiet tension of discovery. It drifts between serenity and unease, as every catch brings you closer to uncovering what lies beneath.

 FISHING IS EVERYTHING

 Each catch feels distinct, with its own patterns and behaviors waiting to be learned. Cast your line, trade your catch, upgrade your gear and explore new depths.

 FISHING FOR CLUES

 Every cast is a chance to uncover something unexpected. The fish you catch become your guides, helping you reach fragments of a long-forgotten mystery hidden beneath the surface. You can lose yourself in the calm of fishing or follow the clues the water offers.

 A PLACE WHERE YOU BELONG

 The world around you moves with time and weather. Fish linger beneath the surface, people follow quiet routines, and the town changes with each passing day. Each person you meet carries their own memories and small joys. Their lives unfold around you, drawing you closer to the peace of a place that slowly begins to feel like home.

 About Fishing is developed by Kevin (The Water Museum), creator of Arctic Eggs. Made out of love for Shenmue and Sega Bass Fishing
 Artist: Angel Perez Guzman Composer: Cameron Ginex

 IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: 
 No fish were harmed in the making of About Fishing. Can’t say the same for the curly fries.

The Ultimate Election Simulator
 Run a complete campaign, from primaries to the general election, across a living political map of the United States.  Plan Your Strategy
 Plan your weekly moves and adapt to new conditions. Open field offices, build volunteer networks, buy advertisements, hire staff, and schedule events in any county and state you see fit. But don't run out of money!
 Unpredictable Events
 No race is the same. Debates, scandals, endorsements, and breaking news can swing the polls overnight. Your opponents will react to your tactics and counter with strategies that match their political style, strengths, and weaknesses.
 Real-Life and Custom Candidates
 Play as a real politician or create a custom candidate. Select unique traits and attributes that affect your campaign’s strengths and vulnerabilities. Will you charm voters as Barack Obama?  Dynamic Polls

Use your magical laptop to turn trash into treasure. A little filter here, a little retouch there... and voila – showroom-ready deception.

Expand your lot, unlock new features like car washes or miracle tuning shops, and make your mark in the world of Totally Legit Business™.

 Beat the Gamemaster

 Face the Fear Together

store.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
store.short: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

store.name: CRYMELIGHT
store.short: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.
store.about:
"You are all sinners." 
 This is Wonderland, a prison for the souls of the dead.
 A girl bereft of her memories is granted the name "Alice" by her guide, the White Rabbit.
 She is led to the site of a tea party.
 There, Alice learns of a rule:
 In this game, only those who can defeat the Queen are granted freedom.
 And so, Alice joins forces with a mysterious girl called Mary and resolves to participate in the game to return to her world.
 Whenever she comes into contact with the sins of her companions, she is able to see the painful pasts they experienced.
 ...Why did the Queen create this world?
 And what awaits the victor? Salvation… or retribution?

 "I'll make these sins mean something." 
 A world after death where one must face their destiny while burdened by sin, full of interesting characters.

After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?
store.about:
STORY
 One day, I lost something very dear to me.
 A collection of cherished portraits, photographed at various cosplay conventions―in an unfortunate accident, the digital camera with all that data goes kaput.
 Witnessing the tragedy, sisters Yua Yamakake and Sana Yamakake say to console me as I wail in sorrow...

 “...How about you take some cosplay photos of us?” 

 I accept. I readily accept.
 These sisters are offering to become my very own cosplay models!
 Amassing every skill I honed as a dressmaking student and a doll costume designer by passion, I make it my duty to create cosplay outfits for the two.

 And as I begin to pick up speed, I get another lucky break.
 In a peculiar turn of events, I’m given a ticket to Costalia, an island resort for all things cosplay.
 There, I’m certain I’ll snap the greatest photo there ever is.

 A quirky and cute visual novel

 Full, professional Japanese voice acting

 1 hour or more of story

Dive into a story-driven cozy horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

 A FALLEN WORLD 
 Streets lie abandoned, buildings rot from the inside out, and strange vegetation reclaims the earth at an accelerated rate. Traces of the past linger in barricaded homes, ransacked offices with scattered supplies, and stores picked clean of basic goods. In a world shaped by desperation, how far will you go to survive?
 FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE 
 Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.
 PROTECT WHAT MATTERS MOST 
 Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.
 COZY HORROR AT HEART

 It has a life of its own

 Dress it up

 A companion that also helps you focus
 Focus Mode. Start a session and your duck settles down and keeps you company quietly until you're done.

 Website Blocking. Tell your duck which sites to keep you off, and it will fly over and close the tab for you.

 Screen time stats. See where your day went, without the guilt trip.

 Bring your friends' ducks over
 Join friends online and their ducks show up on your desktop beside yours. Chat, send emotes, and watch them waddle around together.

 Made to stay out of your way
 Desktop Duck is light on your PC and never covers your full-screen games. Your activity stays on your computer, and all you need is Steam.

 Two players share one goal, but have different roles. The Fish sees the full picture, manages the city layout, production, and incoming threats.
