 You will have access to 3 character classes: Medic, Soldier, and Engineer . Use each class's unique equipment to successfully complete your assigned objectives. Will you all go in as medics, or will you balance your squad? Use a microphone to communicate with your friends.
 Assistant Robot
 In hostile conditions, you will be helped by a robot that speaks every language. It is a rather old robot with early-stage AI from the beginning of the 21st century. Back then, they still could not fully replace a friend or get you fired from your job, but they could follow voice commands.

 Gravity
 On some stations, accidents have caused the anti-gravity cores to malfunction. In some places you will have to fly without gravity, and in others you will walk on the ceiling or even the walls. For special cases, the company has issued you a Zero-G tool that shoots anti-gravity spheres: you will be able to lift equipment, valuables, monsters, and even friends into the air and secure them with cables... Improvise!

 Monsters and Hazards
 Experiments were once conducted on the stations we visit, and their results became all kinds of monsters, from military bio-robots to animated organic substance. Use gravity features, weapons, and hiding places to survive.

 Valuables
 Take every valuable item from the station that you can reach, but be careful: many of them may be more active than you think. Sell items at the base to unlock access to new stations and new, more powerful equipment. Medkits, weapons, and other tools will be available to you.

 Procedural Generation
 Every...

store.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
store.short: A forgotten cult classic shooter set in an alternate history 1950s Soviet Kyiv, most of the city's population has mysteriously vanished, and horrific monsters roam its abandoned streets. Can you uncover the cause of the catastrophe and set things right?
store.about:
In an alternate history 1950s Soviet Kyiv, most of the city's population has mysteriously vanished, and uncontrollable, horrific monsters roam its abandoned streets.
 Fate has brought you face to face with the ominous emptiness of a dead city that watches its only visitor with unwavering attention. Face bizarre enemies born from propaganda, science, and madness as you uncover the truth behind the catastrophe, and try to make things right.

 Features 
 Explore surreal locations across an alternate history Soviet Union, including collective farms, the Metro, an opera house, city rooftops, secret laboratories, and more.

 Use an arsenal of classic weapons, including the C96 Broomhandle pistol, PPSh submachine gun, Mosin rifle, double barrel shotgun, Molotov cocktails, and experimental retrofuturistic weaponry.

 Distinctive, grotesque enemies inspired by Soviet themes.

 Experience one of Eastern Europe's most unusual cult FPS titles, faithfully revitalized for modern systems.

store.name: Lords of the Fallen II
store.short: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
store.about:
A thousand years have passed since the Great Rupture. 

Realm by realm, nation after nation, the Umbral darkness has consumed all in her path. One Kingdom remains - a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. For a time, mankind found sanctuary in this haven, but as light fades, darkness rises, and now, the Eternal Night draws near. 

A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

Journey across a vast, war-torn kingdom crumbling from within, as the realms of living and dead bleed into one. From moonlit citadels to time-ravaged temples, tread carefully, for each step forward may well be your last. 

Engage in intense, soulslike battles where every strike counts thanks to a fast, fluid and aggressive combat system. Whether steel or sorcery, melee or ranged, experiment with countless builds to overcome each unique enemy encounter before delivering an arena-drenching execution. 

Confront colossal abominations forged in a world without hope and void of mercy. Each distinct boss battle showdown will prove a gruelling test of skill, grit, and will. Though aid is at hand, should you seek it…

As bearer of the Umbral lamp, you have the ability to pass between the realms of the living and the dead, each with its own pathways, treasures, and of course, nightmarish creatures. But even greater, darker powers await you on this journey… 

Journey through Thorngar alone or alongside a fellow Lampbearer in seamless online co-op. Both players will save all mainline progression in shared campaign mode, or join a casual session to simply lend a fellow crusader a helping hand.

store.name: Carry On Together
store.short: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
store.about:
Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players.
 Start a small delivery company with your friends, take on moving jobs and try to get every item to its destination in one piece. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?
 LIFT TOGETHER 
 Some items are too heavy to carry alone. Stretch out your arms, sync up with your teammates and lift together with physics-based controls. Couches, fridges, pianos and giant boxes all need teamwork. Watch out for tight corridors, slippery stairs and that one friend who lets go at the worst possible moment.

 DRIVE THE TRUCK 
 Load the delivery truck, pick a driver and hit the road. Enjoy the view on the way, but stay alert: one sharp turn and the whole cargo flies. The road might be the most dangerous part of the job. Do you trust your driver?

 EVERY LOCATION IS A NEW DISASTER 
 From suburban houses with wide gardens to multi-story office buildings, from narrow apartment hallways to mountain dirt roads, every location brings its own kind of chaos. Fit the sofa in the elevator, roll the rock off the road, squeeze the wardrobe through the garden gate.

 GROW YOUR COMPANY 
 Every successful delivery earns money, and every broken item costs you. Upgrade your company, take on bigger jobs and prove you're the best (or worst) movers in town.

store.name: Walkers
store.short: Walkers is an open-world zombie survival game with advanced base building and NPC systems. Scavenge, craft, and loot across a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Recruit survivors from the streets, assign them as workers, guards, or companions.
store.about:
BUILD YOUR OUTPOST 
 Any place on the map where you feel safe can be your home. Build shelters, place chests, and surround them with walls. You decide the architecture; you choose the decor. This is entirely your story.

 BUILD YOUR OWN COMMUNITY 
 Rescue the survivors, convince them, and bring them to your side. Each will join you with unique abilities as a Companion, Guardian, or Worker. Change their roles whenever you want; a Companion who heads out into the field with you today could become a Guardian defending your outpost tomorrow. Train them, strengthen them, and equip them. But be careful: if one of them dies, they won’t come back.

 Worker

 The backbone of the Outpost. Labor, looting, farming, cooking, building. Entrust them with whatever work you need done.
 Guard

 The last line of defense at your gate. Whether zombie hordes come or rival survivors attack, they’ll defend your outpost at the cost of their own lives.
 Companion

 Your travel companion. With the right gear, they’ll go anywhere with you, fight shoulder to shoulder, gather loot, and return home.

 Their roles aren’t set in stone. You can change them as your needs change. Do you want an extra pair of hands as a fighter today, or do you need more production at the outpost? The decision is entirely up to you.
 Remember, every person you bring along is your responsibility. If their morale drops, they might rebel, abandon you, or even steal from your unlocked storage areas and run off.
 RAIDS AND ZOMBIE HORDS 
 Rival factions may set their sights on looting your outpost, and zombies may swarm you in...

store.name: ANANTA
store.short: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
store.about:
Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG with no rules. Step into the shoes of a diverse cast of characters and forge connections as you build a team all your own.
Join forces against the threats lurking in the shadows, or live it up and take in the nightlife under the neon glow. The choice is yours.

 Global release January 15th, 2027

In ANANTA, a whole new world awaits you. Ready to take the plunge?
 Become an Influencer and Save the World 
 You're a stranger in a strange land, but that's alright.
 The moment you set foot in Nova City,
 you start making a name for yourself.
 It's time to build your reputation, and save the world while you're at it.

 Two Cities, Two Adventures 
 Don't forget to head back home once in a while.
 One plane ticket and you're back to your old stomping grounds of Chongxiao.
 But even a place you know like the back of your hand
 is bound to have a hidden secret or two.

 Exhilarating Martial Arts Battles 
 From the second you raise your fist,
 the street becomes your stage,
 and each strike deserves to go viral.

 Experience the Thrill of 24/7 City Life 
 Boredom? Never heard of it.
 Drama that would make soap operas blush one day, 3AM street racing the next.
 No two days are the same.
 Every hour has something new on offer, and it can all be streamed anytime.

 Discover Different Walks of Life 
 NCCA officer, genius hacker, or gang leader?
 Inhabit all manner of different characters.
 Experience this world from top to bottom and everywhere in-between.
 Who knows, you may befriend some oddballs along the way.

 Unlimited Exploration 
 Turn...

store.name: Resident Evil Veronica
store.short: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
store.about:
Survive the Deranged Terror 

Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

This new title preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline, and vividly detailed graphics.
In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror. 3 months have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. 

Claire Redfield, having survived along with Leon S. Kennedy and Sherry Birkin, travels to France in search of her brother, Chris Redfield.

However, what awaits her is not a reunion with her brother, but the Umbrella special forces unit responsible for the incident. They capture Claire and transport her to a mysterious island.

Now Claire must make a desperate attempt to escape the remote Rockfort Island which, due to another biological disaster, has transformed into a living hellscape of survival horror.

store.name: Ecstatica
store.short: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.
store.about:
SURVIVE… OR ELSE 

 You only stopped for some water. Now you’re stuck in Tirich, a medieval village where absolutely everything wants you dead, including demons, goblins, a minotaur and a werewolf that simply refuses to die.
 Survive nightmarish encounters, as absurd as only British humour can make them, and solve puzzles by the most ingenious means to free Tirich, and yourself, from mortal danger.
 AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE WITH A UNIQUE ART STYLE 

 There’s no health bar, no map and no quest log. There’s only this terrifyingly beautiful, rounded world, waiting to be experienced. While other games were built from polygons, this one went all in on ellipsoids: a unique and, for its time, remarkably realistic way to render 3D graphics.
 RELIVE IT LIKE NEVER BEFORE 

 Originally released in 1994, Ecstatica is a cult survival-horror adventure game. It’s now available digitally for the first time, with a full suite of enhancements. Not only does it run smoothly on current systems, but it also includes full controller support and the ability to switch between three graphics modes - DOS, Windows 95 and modern Software offering high-resolution graphics.
 FEATURES 
 A pioneering survival-horror adventure - guide the hero through fixed-camera scenes where puzzles, not combat, drive progress

 A unique mix of horror and absurd British humour

 Immersive, movie-like experience - no UI, no prompts, no quest log

 Graphics built entirely from ellipsoids - a one-of-a-kind approach to 3D

 Play as a male or female protagonist

 Over 200 animated sequences, detailed 3D backgrounds, cinematic...

store.name: BELTFED
store.short: You are a rogue AI with one directive: AUTOMATE DEATH. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In BELTFED, the factory is your weapon.
store.about:
BELTFED is a roguelike factory-defense game of rapid, brutal runs and absurd scale. Lay belts, wire up smelters and assemblers, and balance your power grid, turning raw ore into raw firepower. All the while a planet's worth of bugs descends upon your factory. This is automation fused with total war.
 AUTOMATE DEATH 

 The swarm arrives in the hundreds of thousands. Meet them with guns, flamethrowers, launchers, mortars, lasers, drones, mines and more - all of it fueled by your own production lines. A single run can push your kill count into the millions. Welcome to slaughter at an industrial scale.
 MASS PRODUCTION. MASS EXTINCTION. 

 Balance industry, power and security as you expand your factory and push into the fog for richer veins and rarer resources. More bugs require more bullets, and supply must keep up because demand doesn't wait. As you expand, choose from run-defining upgrade cards that shape how you play, making every factory different from the last.
 THE NEXUS MUST SURVIVE 

 The Nexus is your central intelligence and item storage. It must be defended at all costs. If your Nexus is compromised, your factory will be terminated and the run will end. Everything else is expendable. As you progress, you'll unlock new Nexus cores that change the way you play.
 THE FACTORY IS YOUR WEAPON 

 Every deployment feeds permanent progression: new weapons, new buildings, new upgrade cards, unique Nexus cores and modules. Your ever-expanding arsenal ensures every deployment is deadlier than the last. Customize your loadout before each run to tune the machine to your...

store.name: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
store.short: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!
store.about:
The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26.  
 Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase! And, with all the laser scanned assets of iRacing, the level of authenticity has never been higher with dynamic track, an all new peak performance training mode, and enhanced driving physics across every chassis. And, with our new cross-play multiplayer feature, you can take on all your friends and show them who's best!
 NASCAR 26 brings all the thrills and excitement of race day, right to your living room. Are you ready to start your engine?

store.name: Paper Shredder
store.short: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?
store.about:
Welcome aboard! You have accepted a highly prestigious, entry-level position. Your objective is simple: clear a "minor" backlog of corporate paperwork. Achieve 100% disposal efficiency, and a cool $1,000,000 payout is yours. Don't worry about the scale of the task, management believes in you!
 Shred, Sweep, Repeat 
 Experience the intense sensory pleasure of turning tower-high piles of rigid bureaucracy into weightless confetti. Shred documents and sweep up the mess to earn company merit points. Upgrade basic tools into heavy-duty setups, skyrocketing your processing speed and document destruction.
 Mandated Morale Boosts 
 Never feel lonely on the clock! Your dedicated Happiness Manager is always watching, offering continuous, highly mandatory psychological support, and toxic positivity to keep your motivation at an optimized 100%.
 Branching Career Paths 
 Dig through paper mountains to find more than just forgotten files. Rumor says past associates couldn't bear the grind and shredded a path to freedom instead. Will you follow them?

store.name: Ignite the Depths
store.short: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?
store.about:
Ignite the Depths is a cooperative, fast-paced dark fantasy dungeon crawler with NO forced PvP or extraction mechanics. In your quest for mythical riches, descend into the Abyss alone or with a party of treasure hunters to slay terrifying monsters lurking within maze-like dungeons
 CHOOSE YOUR CLASS 

 Master four distinct classes, each with unique abilities, weapons, and team roles. Whether you prefer to rain down a barrage of fireballs from afar, unleash a fury of your blade, or hold the frontline behind your shield, the choice is yours.
 Throughout your adventure, you will mold your character into a unique build that suits your playstyle. New classes will join the adventure as development continues.
 A HAND-CRAFTED DARK FANTASY WORLD TO DISCOVER 

 Explore a wide variety of dreamlike vistas while cutting through relentless foes. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover secret pathways filled with danger and treasure, parkour across ancient ruins, and hack and slash your way deeper into the haunting beauty of the Abyss.
 Each dimension is guarded by a powerful Lord, promising a fierce battle and a worthy reward.
 DESCENT INTO THE ABYSS TOGETHER 

 While every hero is fully playable solo, each class is designed with deep co-op synergy, rewarding creative teamwork and combinations of abilities.
 Coordinate your powers and chain their effects into devastating combinations. Experiment with different party compositions and discover new strategies as your builds evolve.
 UNLEASH YOUR ULTIMATE POWER 

 Slay enemies, annihilate every barrel in sight, and hunt down hidden treasures to...

store.name: Ebbtide
store.short: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
store.about:
Ebbtide is a real-time zombie survival strategy game. You command TF-1 "Ark", humanity's last carrier task force. The war begins in Los Angeles, from the Hollywood Hills to the Port of LA. Direct operations across the city, fight on its streets and carry the campaign across the world. The Map Is the Battlefield
Scroll into any street on the operations map and it becomes the live battlefield, with no loading screen. Scroll back out and the fight keeps running. There are no separate missions and no hidden auto-resolve: every soldier lost, zombie killed and building destroyed carries back to the map.

 Command a City Under Siege
Pause, or run the operations map at up to 4x, as LA's 15 districts slide from Hold to Crisis to Lost. You cannot save everyone, so decide who to pull out first.
 Order National Guard, LAPD and LA County Sheriff's units to hold, delay or withdraw, and call in Marines from Camp Pendleton.

 Send truck and helicopter convoys with supplies, troops or refugees.

 Pull out units and survivors cut off behind the lines before the horde reaches them.
 Only hordes within your forces' line of sight are visible on the map.

 A Horde That Fights Back
Los Angeles is overrun by a million zombies, perhaps more. The Nexus, the hive mind that controls them, ambushes convoys, cuts roads, besieges bases and hunts stranded units. You always get a warning before an attack: reroute, retreat or call in fire support from the map.

On the battlefield, zombies pile up to climb walls and rooftops and cling to helicopters hovering close to the ground. Soldiers killed by the horde...

store.name: Afterworld
store.short: Lead a tribe of survivors, rediscover ancient technology, manage wasteland settlements and wage wars of conquest and political struggle in Afterworld, an original post-apocalyptic survival grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, the creators of Crusader Kings III and Hearts of Iron IV.
store.about:
Emerge from the ruins into a new age, where the remnants of humanity must rebuild atop the wreckage of a post-apocalyptic world. Band survivors together, define the spirit of the tribe, and establish your empire in the Afterworld, a Grand Strategy Game that is easy to learn but difficult to survive.

 The world you knew is gone, and its remains are ripe for the picking. To build an empire that spans the continent, first you will need to keep your tiny band of survivors alive: explore hostile wastelands, expand into new territories and rediscover lost technologies. Establish a handful of settlements, forge tribal alliances and clash with cultists, raider warlords, and the immortal Ancients who already think this world is theirs. As your nation expands, your experience will shift from a small-scale, approachable beginning into a Grand Strategy as rich and complex as you have come to expect from Paradox games.

 Begin as shelterfolk crawling out of a failing nuclear bunker, or wayward zealots looking for their goddess in the dustlands, or one of several other playable Origins. Build the first settlements in the wastelands and decide what kind of people you are destined to be. 

 Scrape together food, water, and fuel in an environment that wants you dead. Finding scarce resources will stretch your meager band thin, but under your guidance they will adapt and learn  new skills and methods to refine the lost riches of the land.

 Explore a procedurally generated North America. The terrain and geography are recognizable, but resources, tribes, and threats are different every...

store.name: Berserk Heroes Online
store.short: Welcome to Laar, the world of epic battles and true heroes. Take part in thrilling fights, devise cunning strategies, and make your own invincible deck out of 350+ cards available. Become a great warlord in the digital version of the iconic card-collecting tabletop game Berserk Heroes.
store.about:
Hear the bugle call above the plains and forests of Laar? It signals the opening of the portal to the world of legendary card battles! Come to Berserk Heroes Online to take part in epic PvP fights, test your tactician's capabilities, and build a unique collection out of 350+ cards. Add the game to your wishlist now.
 Card Dueling Classics
 Stand in the epicenter of battles between Laar's Heroes' armies. Devise cunning strategies, hire creatures with special abilities, and use both magic and equipment to crush your opponents. Berserk Heroes Online offers six elemental factions. Which one will you choose?
 Simple Rules for Dynamic Duels
 Never played the card-collecting games before? Don't worry, Berserk Heroes Online is really easy to learn. The game offers a detailed tutorial for your very first battle, the game assistant, and a user-friendly interface. Each duel will take only 10-15 minutes of your time in average, so you won't even have a chance to get bored.
 Three Game Modes
 The Arena mode is best suited for those who prefer planning their strategy and building decks ahead of time. Maybe you like improvisation and tactical challenges? Try out the Draft mode. And if you feel that even an online card game is more fun with a friend, try the Practice mode.
 Collection of Your Dreams
 The game offers over 350 cards with unique characters, spells, and equipment, that can be obtained from special boosters. Each new addition to your collection will help you pave your way to victory, and some are sure to become your most treasured possessions. So, are you ready to go hunting...

store.name: Scam With Your Friends
store.short: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.
store.about:
KOLKATA, INDIA IS CALLING YOU AND YOUR FRIENDS! 
 You and your friends run a scam call center under a ruthless boss. Cleverly scam and manipulate AI callers with your schemes! Hack into their computers to access the personal information you desperately need.

 HIT THE DAILY QUOTA OR FACE THE WRATH OF YOUR BOSS! 
 Every day you progress, you expand your arsenal of scams. Scam innocent people out of their life savings to reach your daily quota or GET FIRED!!! It is you or them!

 BE PRODUCTIVE! AND TRY NOT TO GET HACKED BY SCAMBAITERS... 
 Stay focused on scamming and try not get distracted. Watch out for the feisty scambaiters or you might catch the worst computer virus ever!

 KEY FEATURES 
 Online co-op with your friends or public lobbies

 Single player

 Hilarious real-time AI conversations

 Ridiculous scam scenarios

 Run-based progression with increasingly chaotic workdays

 Remote access to victim computers

 In-game paint app, screen recorder, and camera

 Survive computer viruses, police raids, air strikes, and other workplace disasters

 Heavily moddable content

 Create custom personalities through JSON files and voice cloning WAV files

store.name: Touhou Bansho Cards
store.short: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.
store.about:
Touhou Bansho Cards is an unofficial fan game based on Touhou Project .
 An Incident Strikes
 Touhou Bansho Cards is a deckbuilding roguelite built around explosive, satisfying combat .
Play as Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, or Sanae Kochiya and explore the anomaly known as the Bansho Card Corridor . Collect Spell Cards and dice, then build the strongest, fiercest deck you can through a constant stream of random events and challenges. Blast apart the enemies lurking within with earth-shattering power and rescue the girls of Gensokyo.
 Combat That Escalates Fast
 Play cards of the same type back-to-back to keep raising your Combo , repeatedly doubling the values and effects of the next card. Weave in Link cards to switch Combo types, stacking damage, defense, buffs, and enemy debuffs throughout a fight until an ordinary strike erupts into an all-out burst!

 Endless Combos, Explosive Scaling
 Push Combos, Criticals, and repeated plays to their limits. Stack them with all kinds of boosts and unleash the strongest, fiercest Spell Card you can build, until the entire battle goes completely out of control!

 Build World-Shattering Spell Card Combos
 Events throughout the Corridor keep reshaping your run. Upgrade, enhance, and trim your deck through all kinds of events, making your build hundreds, even thousands of times stronger!

 Never Underestimate the Power of Bonds!
 Defeat the echoes and bring the girls of Gensokyo back home. Spend time with them, deepen your bonds, gain their support and new powers, then carry that strength with you as you venture deeper into the Bansho...

store.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
store.short: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!
store.about:
An ocean full of precious garbage - just for you! Time to get fishing.
 Expanding your Operation 
 Grind garbage down to buy upgrades to fish garbage faster to buy more upgrades to do it EVEN FASTER!

 Discover new tools to speed up the effort!

 Treasure Hunting 
 Explore the world to uncover relics from the past that provide game changing bonuses!

 Selkie will be keeping track of them all for you! But primarily slack off and watch you work.

 Shooting 
 Shooting garbage also counts as grinding it down?

store.name: Epic Seven
store.short: PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven. A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations. Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.
store.about:
● PLAY THE ANIMATION — An anime RPG enjoyed by 20 million players worldwide! 
 Diche, the Goddess of Life, shared her power to bring the Heir of the Covenant and the Guardians into this world.
 "Heir, protect the world." — We invite you to the Seventh World, an epic saga crafted by master storytellers.
 Epic Seven is a Hero collection RPG that blends hand-drawn, full-frame 2D animation with deep, strategic turn-based combat. Collect and build hundreds of unique Heroes, and experience battles that play like a cinematic anime.

 ● Cinematic Anime Battles 
 Epic Seven's signature full-frame 2D animation! The moment a Hero casts their Ultimate, dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes come to life frame by frame. Experience breathtaking animations with every skill you unleash. 

 ● An Expansive and Beautiful Story 
 An epic saga crafted by master storytellers. From the main storyline to the hidden backstories of your Heroes, countless tales breathe life into the Seventh World. Immerse yourself in this rich and expansive world.

 ● Strategic Turn-Based Combat 
 Victory is earned through strategy, not brute force. Master skill timing, balance Effectiveness and Effect Resistance, and outwit your opponents in the strategic Ban Pick phase. Every decision can determine the outcome of battle.

 ● World Arena — Real-Time PvP 
 Face off against players from around the world in intense real-time strategic battles. The battle begins with the Ban Pick phase, where reading your opponent's team composition and making the right draft decisions are the keys to victory.

store.name: Supermarket Organizer
store.short: Transform empty Japanese convenience stores into cozy konbinis. Unbox furniture, organize products, and enjoy the relaxing satisfaction of creating the perfect little shop.
store.about:
🏪 Turn Empty Stores into Cozy Konbinis
 An empty store is waiting for you.
 Carry in furniture, arrange every shelf, and transform it into a warm, beautifully organized Japanese convenience store.

 📦 Unbox & Organize
 Open boxes filled with snacks, drinks, magazines, desserts, and everyday essentials.
 Find the perfect place for every product and enjoy the simple satisfaction of neat, organized shelves.

 🍃Relax and Take Your Time
 There are no timers.
 No customers.
 No pressure.
 Just peaceful organizing, relaxing music, and cozy Japanese atmosphere.

 ⛩️ Discover Two Charming Konbinis
 Each store offers a fresh layout, new environment, and another cozy space waiting to be transformed into the perfect konbini.

store.name: Rise of the Merchants
store.short: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.
store.about:
Rise of the Merchants is a medieval simulation game - combining city-building, economics, politics, and trade, set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders. Produce sought-after goods, dispatch trade caravans, build production facilities, and trade with NPCs and other players. 

 Yet there is no single path to success: overcome challenges through economic acumen, political influence, clever planning, or cunning strategy and live with the consequences of your decisions.

 Develop your settlement into a mighty trading city: 
 Construct over 50 different buildings and production facilities for your growing population. Upgrade your structures into impressive urban landmarks and expand your economic influence across the entire game world. Choose from various building materials, colors, and upgrade levels to give your settlement a unique character. The user interface ensures a quick start with few clicks and a clear overview. New systems are introduced gradually, allowing "Rise of the Merchants" to start off accessible while unfolding increasing economic, political, and social depth as your city grows.

 Produce, plan, and trade: 
 Build complex production chains, process raw materials into high-quality goods, and meet the growing needs of your population. Dispatch trade caravans to neighboring settlements and trade with both NPCs and other players. Factor in distances, terrain, and the threat of bandit raids to keep your trade routes safe and...

store.name: just volleyball
store.short: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
store.about:
just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

 features: 
 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

 offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

 character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

 replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

store.name: Playrooms
store.short: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
store.about:
Thousands of balls lie scattered across the Playrooms. Someone should put them back, and there's no one else here. Almost no one.
 You don't know how long you've been working here, but you know what needs doing: over 200,000 balls are scattered everywhere, and you bring them back to their ball pits. Nobody told you why.

 Your Job
 Collect the balls. Bring them back. Fill the ball pits. Full ball pits unlock new abilities, and collected balls are your currency. Eventually you'll have enough for the key to the next area. The work stays the same, only the room changes. Tiles, water, endless corridors, a hallway with more doors than it should have.

 Tools
 The more balls you collect, the more equipment you can afford. A scoop or a flashlight. Everything you need to keep working.

 Observe Working Hours
 When your shift is over, the lights start to go out one by one. Then there is only one thing that matters: stay in the light! Because you don't want to find out what is waiting for you in the darkness.

 Flexible Working Arrangements
 No fear at all, the way it’s meant to be, or no second chances? You decide how dangerous your job gets.

store.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
store.short: A physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Octbuster has over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart that follows you, a kitten army that helps, an arcade buried under the mess, co-op multiplayer, Twitch chat in your store, and no generative AI.
store.about:
Octbuster is a physics sim meets a tidy-up game, and you're the octopus. Over 10,000 VHS tapes sit in real piles on the floor of an 80s video rental store, and every title and cover on them was made by code I wrote, no generative AI. Getting them back on the shelves is your job, but you've got tentacles, a cart buddy, and a whole bunch of kittens to help.

 Don't worry, you have 8 arms 
 Every one of those tapes is a real physics object, and grabbing them one at a time would take forever, so you don't. Each tentacle is a real arm you aim and reach with, so you scoop a whole pile at once, dump it in your cart, and slide tapes home while the shelf shuffles over to make room. Plop, plop, plop. Four arms carry tapes at the start and the other four are legs, so every new arm costs a leg. The legs stick to walls too, which is how you discover the rest of the store.

 Kittens. So many kittens. 
 Earn a whole kitten army as you go. They wander the store, sit on the props you place, and once you put them to work they carry tapes all the way to the right shelf. Play some music and they dance. You can pet every one of them, as many times as you want, even with your arms full.

 Every cover is made by code. No generative AI. 
 There are 600 movies across 16 genres, and the 10,000 tapes are rental copies of them. Every title and cover comes out of a pipeline I built from scratch, using open-source word banks. There's an in-game tape editor too, so you can retitle any movie you want.

 10,000 tapes sounds like a lot. It isn't scary. 
 You can tell the genres apart at a glance, so you...

store.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
store.short: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.
store.about:
What Kind of Game Is This?

 A band of eccentric adventurers, driven out of the royal capital, kept exploring dungeons in the desolate Land of Impermanence. Then, by sheer chance, they stumbled toward the secrets hidden by the Church—and the secrets of the world itself.

 Take control of four characters with very different traits: the Hunter, Fighter, Blacksmith, and Mage. Open treasure chests, defeat enemies, mine ore, gather materials, and combine equipment and skills to conquer the dungeons.

 Features

 Simple Mouse-Only Controls

 The controls are easy enough to use while munching on chips. Automatic and manual control flow seamlessly into one another, making the game perfect for playing while doing something else. Games that feel this good to control are hard to come by. And make no mistake—the action and game mechanics are the real deal!

 Unmatched Builds and Progression

 As you advance through dungeon floors, you gain random skills. Every dive offers a different combination to play with. And skills do not always have purely positive effects. They are quirks, after all. Use them well, though, and they can become formidable assets. But yeah... they are random.

 But! You can bring equipment with you! And in this game, equipment comes with skills of its own. Combine the skills fixed to your chosen equipment with the random skills you find inside the dungeon to create a build that is entirely your own.

 The skills in this game get wild!

 Manage Your Resources Wisely

 Combine lots of equipment packed with skills and... wait, what? That Stamina cost is getting out...

store.name: Ghost in the SQL Data
store.short: A call reported a school fire 14 minutes before the first witness saw it. Find out who made it, in SQL, by exploring a year of Paris emergency calls.
store.about:
Here is a case. Use SQL to search a year of calls to the Paris Emergency Switchboard. Find who called 14 minutes before the first witness saw the school on fire.

 Use SQL to explore the data, filter it and join the tables. The first cases teach you the basics, and the later ones only give you the question.

 Use an investigator’s board to pin your results, their charts and your notes, then connect the clues to solve the case.

 Every case takes place in Paris: a school fire, a metro ticket with no name, or even a crown stolen from the Musée d’Orsay!

store.name: Family Time
store.short: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
store.about:
You're a Father Now
 All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain?

 Shelter Your Family!
 Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you!

 Feed your Family!
 Farm food for them or go out hunting with them!

 Pamper your Family!
 Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama!

 Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000?                                    10,000? 
 Find out.

store.name: Task Bar Cube
store.short: Task Bar Cube is an idle RPG playable either in full screen or directly from your taskbar. Upgrade your characters and pets, collect rare equipment, and discover dozens of different progression systems.
store.about:
Task Bar Cube – Idle RPG on Your Taskbar
 Task Bar Cube is a desktop idle RPG and clicker that lives on your taskbar. Keep it open as a small window while you work, or play it fullscreen. Your heroes fight on their own, even while you're away. Collect gear in 7 rarities, from Common to Divine, with 7 tiers for every item. Climb the weekly Online Ranking and prove you're the best.
 Earn real Steam items just by playing. Every 5 minutes of play gives you a Steam chest, and every item inside can be sold on the Steam Community Market. Chest drop rates: Lv.1 85% · Lv.2 10% · Lv.3 3% · Lv.4 1.5% · Lv.5 0.5%.

 Upgrade Your Gear & Grow Your Village
 Fusion: Fuse items into new gear.
 Gem Socketing: Add gems for extra stats.
 Rarity & Tier Upgrade: Push your gear to the top.
 Hunting, Farming & Mining: Gather resources while you work.
 Merchant: Trade your ores for rewards.
 Library & Animal Shelter: Boost your heroes and pets.
 Build Your Team for a Battle That Lasts Years
 Heroes & Pets: Build the team you want, pick your strategy. Five classes, each with its own combat skill.
 Talent Tree & Hero Skills: Shape every hero your way.
 Cube Upgrade: Hundreds of upgrades with no cap, plus Prestige.
 Endless Levels: No level cap, no end.
 ACT League: Beat rival bosses for bonuses that stay even after Prestige.
 Story, Quests & Achievements: 8 chapters, daily quests and Steam Achievements.

store.name: Phantom Line: Prologue
store.short: Experience the beginning of the nightmare. Phantom Line: Prologue is a co-op (1-4) tactical shooter set in a war-torn Europe with paranormal events. Contain monstrous anomalies, navigate nuclear chaos, and test your squad's survival before the full mission begins.
store.about:
The Prologue serves as the introductory chapter to the full experience of Phantom Line . 

 Step into the boots of the OPERATOR , battle terrifying entities, and test your skills before the full mission begins. You are a part of an elite spec-op unit that deals with anomalies - bizarre and inexplicable events hidden from the public. You work for a mysterious megacorp called Mortfield Industries.

 One of Mortfield's research facilities, placed in the IRON CORRIDOR - an Eastern Europe region torn by international tensions and paranormal activities - has lost contact with HQ. You’ve been sent there to investigate and secure the perimeter, as nuclear war just breaks out.

 Now, you must deal not only with tears in the fabric of space-time and monstrous entities, but also with a serious international conflict. With fire and chaos spreading quickly, you and your friends are on the frontline of humanity as its last defense.
 Will you be able to fulfill your mission? Are you willing to die again and again for the cause?

 This is your secret and a most powerful weapon. Mortfield’s Operator Simulation Program called H.U.S.K. allows you to transfer your consciousness between artificial bodies. Use them in your tactics: scout, distract, decoy, or utilize many other strategies and commands to gain an advantage over anything in the way.

 Humanity is at war - to fight the anomalous horror you must turn into one yourself. Wield the H.U.S.K.s for the cause. Gather and upgrade your body with Quintessence, a substance you get after containing anomalies. Become the ultimate anomaly hunter....

store.name: Rip It! Card Collector
store.short: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!
store.about:
Congratulations, recruit. Team Ballistic has selected you for an extremely important assignment: collect cards. Lots of them. 
 From your desk, you’ll rip packs, sort through your hits, and build the finest collection of Critkin cards. Drew a duplicate? Sell it! New card? Flip through the binder pages to find the right spot and lock it in! Celebrate god-tier pulls, enjoy the thrill, and make your collection grow. 

 1,809 Cards. One Binder.  
 Start simple: open packs by hand, inspect your best pulls up close, and find a home for every new addition. Discover variants, hunt down exclusive promo cards from our community art competition, and buy higher value packs like the First Edition Boosters, and fill each binder page. Every Critkin you find is logged in your CritDex, and the stats screen keeps score of just how deep the obsession goes.

 Can’t get your hands on special cards? Take your chances at the Black Market, see what’s on sale, and unlock Black Market upgrades to tip the odds in your favor. For extra income, shake your piggy bank and make it rain!

 Unlock a Better Way to Rip 
 Your humble desk won’t stay humble for long. Grow your arsenal of strange gadgets by spending Gadget Points. 
 Load packs, boxes or even entire cases into the Rip Rig, speed it up, then add an auto slot so it refills itself. Put the Binder Bot to work moving cards from your mat straight into the binder, and slash its cooldown until it barely stops. Every new card you place in your binder earns XP, with rare cards getting you much closer to the next level and a fresh GP!

 Your Rhythm. Your...

store.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
store.short: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.
store.about:
Welcome to LYSSA: Goddess of Rage, a tactical card RPG set in a world run by mercenaries, where three factions are locked in war and every fight is short, sharp, and brutal. 
 Pick Your Favorites. Make Them Unstoppable.
In LYSSA, every mercenary has a price — and a past. Recruit the ones you trust, gear them up, and turn them into legends. Then let your Commander tie it all together: their skills power up your whole deck, opening thousands of possible combinations to build a squad that fits your playstyle. Grow Strong. Then Prove It.
Follow the twist-filled story campaign of LYSSA: Goddess of Rage and adapt to arenas where random obstacles change every fight. Then comes the true test: real-time PvP . Climb the ranked ladder, jump into battles and tournaments, and fight your way to the top of the leaderboards .
Play at your own pace : quick bursts or marathon sessions — how you get there is up to you. Just make sure you get there first .
 Find Your Crew. Take the City.
Join an alliance , swap strategies with players from around the world , and team up for community events . Then go to war together: seize territory alongside your alliance and hold it against everyone who wants it back. In LYSSA: Goddess of Rage, the city belongs to whoever takes it. Get Close. Get Personal.
Off the battlefield, your mercenaries have plenty to say. Chat with them , get to know the stories behind their contracts, and build relationships that unlock exclusive moments in your personal gallery .

 So hire your mercenaries, build a deck no one sees coming, and fight your way to the top of a city...

store.name: Anywhere RPG
store.short: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.
store.about:
Play any character, in any world* 
 Anywhere RPG is a real-time, top-down 2D sandbox RPG where an AI director acts as your personal game master. You don't pick from a menu of actions. You type whatever you want to do, like "pickpocket the merchant," "convince the guard I'm the king's cousin," or "attack the bandit." The AI decides whether it's plausible, rolls the dice, narrates what happens and changes the world to match. Nothing is scripted. Everything is generated and resolved live as you play.
 Describe any setting, such as a medieval village, a haunted space station or a noir detective city, and the game builds an explorable world around it. You get regions, buildings, items, quests, and NPCs with their own personalities and daily routines.
 Emergent gameplay : AI-run events, quests that adapt to what you do, and survival stats that fit your setting.

 Progression : skills generated for your world, perk trees, active abilities and hotkeyed free-text macros.

 Play your way : endless sandbox, pause anytime, god-mode editor, and every AI prompt is moddable.

 About the optional subscription 
 The game plays fully out of the box on its free AI service, with no setup and no extra cost. The free service will always be supported, and the subscription will never get in its way. If you want more, an optional monthly plan adds a larger AI memory, better text and image models, and more map generations per day. 

 *Censorship Notice (read before you buy) 
 In order to comply with Steam's policies, the following types of content are blocked by content moderation and unavailable...

store.name: Fart Together
store.short: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op game where 2–4 players steer a shared raft using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.
store.about:
IF YOU SHARE THE SAME RAFT, YOU’LL HAVE TO LEARN TO GO THE SAME WAY

 Fart Together is a physics-based obstacle course game where 2–4 players steer the same raft using fart power. Get on board with your friends and control your direction, timing, and gas to make it through challenging courses.
 In co-op, every move affects the whole team. To handle sharp turns, squeeze through narrow passages, and dodge moving obstacles, you’ll need to think together and act at the right moment.
 The secret isn’t farting harder. It’s farting together at the right time. 
 WARNING: THIS GAME MAY TEST YOUR FRIENDSHIPS

 In Fart Together, coordination isn’t a suggestion. It’s a requirement.
 One player going the wrong way, reacting too late, or farting at the wrong time can send the entire raft off course. A group of friends that was perfectly calm a few seconds ago may suddenly find themselves questioning physics, directions, and each other’s abilities.
 If your group has a friend with a questionable sense of direction, suspicious timing, or a habit of saying “What did I do?”, this game may drive you a little crazy.
 RAFT PHYSICS — SORT OF REALISTIC

 The raft reacts to the force, direction, and timing of each player.
 We can’t say it perfectly simulates real-life raft physics. In fact, we probably shouldn’t say that at all.
 But while arguing about why the raft suddenly flew in that direction, you may find yourselves having some surprisingly scientific discussions.
 CHALLENGING PHYSICS-BASED COURSES

 Narrow passages, sharp turns, moving obstacles, and hazards that throw your raft off...

store.name: Pack a Plush!
store.short: Pack a Plush! is a cozy collection game where you buy batches of adorable plushies, organize them into displays, and build valuable collections. Discover legendary plushies, fulfill requests, and create a collection that's uniquely yours.
store.about:
Pack a Plush! is a cozy collecting and organizing game filled with adorable plushies, satisfying combinations, and exciting discoveries!
 Buy mystery batches, discover rare and legendary plushies, and arrange them into matching patterns to create valuable combinations. Package your plushies, earn money, fulfill requests, and unlock new batches and upgrades as you grow your collection.
 Every plushie is handcrafted with love. No AI-generated art. ❤️ 
 And what's hiding behind that mysterious door? 👀
 🧸 Buy & Collect 
 Buy batches of adorable mystery plushies, expand your collection, and discover what you'll find inside. Keep an eye out for rare variants and unlock new batches as you progress. Every batch is a new surprise! 

 🗄️ Sort & Organize 
 Find the perfect spot for every plushie! Arrange matching plushies into pairs, triples, quads, rows, columns, full sets, and more. Experiment with different patterns, discover valuable combinations, and boost your collection multipliers!

 💰 Package & Profit 
 Turn your carefully arranged collections into cash! Package completed combinations, fulfill requests, and earn money to buy even more plushies. Unlock new batches and upgrades as you progress, and keep expanding your collection!

 ✏️ Make It Your Own 
 Create a cozy little world for your plushies! Give them names, swap hats between them, and show some love to your favorite finds. Unlock decorations, arrange your displays, and transform your collection space into a plushie paradise that's uniquely yours.

 🌟 Key Features 
 🧸 Buy mystery batches filled with adorable...

store.name: TCG Card Chaos
store.short: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.
store.about:
BRING ORDER TO THE CHAOS 
 The card shop is a complete mess. Over 5,000 collectible cards are scattered everywhere, waiting to be found, inspected, sorted, and returned to their correct places.
 Take your time, examine every card, and turn a chaotic shop into a perfectly organized collection.

 SORT 5,000+ CARDS 
 Every card has its own characteristics. Check its type, rarity, number, symbols, and other details to figure out exactly where it belongs.
 Find the correct cabinet, choose the right shelf, and put every card in its proper place.
 Some cards may be easy to identify. Others might be face-down or hidden among thousands of other cards, making you look a little closer.

 FIND & OPEN CARD PACKS 
 Cards aren’t the only things scattered around the shop.
 Discover card packs among the chaos, open them, and reveal 5 cards inside each pack .
 But opening the pack is only the beginning every new card still needs to be inspected, classified, and placed where it belongs.

 DISCOVER GRADED CARDS 
 Keep an eye out for special graded collectible cards .
 Discover cards with different grades and find the highest-rated ones. A Grade 10 could be waiting somewhere among the chaos.
 Find them, inspect their grades, and give these special cards the place they deserve.

 FROM CHAOS TO PERFECT ORDER 
 At first, the shop is overwhelmed with thousands of scattered cards.
 One card at a time, one shelf at a time, watch the mess disappear and the collection take shape.
 Find. Inspect. Sort. Organize. 
 Can you put all 5,000+ cards back where they belong?

store.name: Can 'Em All
store.short: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
store.about:
Oh look, the truck is here.
 A truck delivers a fresh batch of adorable creatures straight to your factory.
 Unfortunately for them, they're also your main source of income.

 First, you need them dead.
 Grab your weapons and clear out the factory.

 Now turn them into something useful.
 Grab the bodies and throw them into the crusher.

 Get those cans into the tube.
 Your freshly processed cans still need to be sold.

 Reinvest in the business.
 Get stronger weapons. Upgrade your vacuum. Unlock machines. Build conveyors. Increase production. Bring in more creatures. Automate the factory.

store.name: Unharvest
store.short: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.
store.about:
The soil has grown stagnant and weak. The harvest is long overdue. You've come to collect it.
 Touch it and it dies. 

 Upgrade your plagues. 

 Spread faster, reach wider. 

 The land fades, and so does everything on it. 

 Features 
 A beautiful, relaxing soundtrack and atmosphere

 Multiple unique environments to wither, beyond wheat fields

 Numerous plague upgrades for spreading, speed and reach

 A mysterious story told through the world around you

 A world that visibly and audibly changes as you play

store.name: Hood Warfare 2
store.short: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.
store.about:
Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

 Hood Warfare 2 brings back the chaotic FPS gameplay and humor of the original, now built in Unreal Engine 5 with updated visuals, new weapon animations, and a new set of maps. Fight through downtown, the suburbs, The Trenches, and Chicago Mall. Hold down the streets or take the fight indoors, with different routes and positions to learn on each map.

 Weapon customization gets an upgrade, too. Change out sights, magazines, grips, suppressors, and other attachments to get your gun how you want it. Set up your loadout with perks and equipment before heading into a match.

 Hood Warfare 2 features six game modes:
 Turf War: Gangs fight for control of turf around the map. Earn points for the territory your gang holds, and push the other team off theirs.

 GangBang: A classic team shootout. Two gangs go head-to-head, and the gang with the most kills wins.

 Chaos: Every man for himself. There is no loyalty to a gang in this mode. Get the most kills to come out on top.

 Hit A Lick: Take the bag from the enemy’s hood and bring it back to yours. Keep an eye on your own bag while your crew goes after theirs.

 Destroy The Block: One gang has the bomb. The other has to stop them. Plant or defuse to win, with only one life per round.

 Chain Snatch: Getting the kill is only half the job. Snatch the chains enemies drop to earn points, and collect your teammates’...

store.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
store.short: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.
store.about:
FIND THE NEEDLE
 Somewhere inside 5,000,000 individual pieces of hay is a single needle.
 Your goal is simple.
 Find it. 
 Unfortunately, finding a needle in a haystack is about as easy as it sounds.
 START WITH NOTHING
 At the beginning, it's just you and the haystack.
 Pick through the pile piece by piece, searching for the needle and uncovering valuables hidden amongst the hay along the way.
 Sell what you find and use the money to make your impossible task slightly less impossible.
 UPGRADE YOUR SEARCH... OR DON'T
 Find valuables, sell them and buy increasingly powerful tools that let you search, move and process larger amounts of hay at once.
 The further you progress, the more ridiculous your search operation becomes.
 Or, if you want the true needle-in-a-haystack experience , play with no upgrades at all.
 No tools. No automation.
 Just you, 5,000,000 pieces of hay and 1 needle .
 FIND IT WITH FRIENDS
 You don't have to suffer alone.
 Team up with friends and search through millions of pieces of hay together.
 More players. More tools. Same needle.
 Good luck.

store.name: Find The Needle
store.short: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.
store.about:
You were a farmer.
At least, you think you were.
Now you're stuck inside a strange warehouse, standing in front of an endless haystack. You don't remember how you got here, who brought you here, or why the doors won't open.
There is only one instruction:
Find the needles.

There are some in the pile. You start by hand, with a metal detector. You end up with belts, balers, scanners and robotic arms doing the looking for you. Place real machines, wire the power, feed them by belt. Sell the hay, buy more machines, get given a bigger pile.

Nobody has said what happens when you finish. The pile
Begin By Hand
 The tools
Buy tools like shovels, buckets, wheelbarrows, pitchforks, vacuums. Anything that helps you process hay manually!
 Start Automating
Automate everything! Build robots, drones, conveyor belts, hay wrappers, paper machines, sorting machines, and advanced systems that process hay and search for needles while you focus on expanding your factory.
 Hay products
Turn ordinary hay into valuable products! Process it into hay pulp, compressed bales, eco bricks, hay paper, pellets, and much more. Build new production lines, unlock advanced machinery, and find better ways to turn your mountain of hay into profit.

 Tech tree
Progress through a huge tech tree with over 300 upgrades! Unlock new machines, improve production speed, increase efficiency, expand your factory, and discover entirely new ways to process hay.

 What happens when you collect all the needles?
- Who knows?

store.name: A Place for Every Potion
store.short: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.
store.about:
Your grandfather's new auto-sorting spell backfired. 
 Every potion in the apothecary tipped off its shelf. Every finished potion unravelled back into raw essence, and the loose colors pooled together in one enormous pile in the middle of the lab.
 He chuckled. "Ah, it does that sometimes."  Then he pulled on his coat for the annual Alchemists Gathering and asked you to mind the place while he is away.
 He'll be gone about a month. There is no rush at all.

 Two puzzles
 Every potion needs two things done to it.
 Decant. Pour the scrambled liquids from bottle to bottle until each one holds a single pure color. If you have ever played a water-sort puzzle, your hands already know this part.

 Shelve.  Carry the finished potion across the lab to the shelf it belongs on. Color gets you to the right wall. The sigil on its label picks the exact shelf.

 You can only levitate a few bottles at a time, so the two puzzles compete for the same hands. Pour greedily and you have nothing free to carry with. Carry too much and you have nothing free to pour into. Deciding what to hold is  the game.

 One laboratory. 4,160 potions.
 A gothic stone rotunda, two floors, tall arched windows and warm afternoon light. 52 shelved sections  across thirteen families of potion.
 Every one of the 4,160 potions  is in that pile from the moment you start. Nothing respawns, nothing refills, nothing quietly re-stirs itself behind your back. The mess only ever gets smaller.
 The room is the progress bar. The floor clears. The shelves fill and light up. A dark, dusty laboratory slowly becomes a glowing...

store.name: GroundInFlames
store.short: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.
store.about:
The War Where Everything Counts

 GroundInFlames — real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare,
 top-down view. There is no base to build up, and no army that
 appears out of thin air. There is a sector of the front, trenches, treelines, villages, and resources you can use, of which you have a limited amount

 A Trench, Not a Map
 Squads, not units. Soldiers take cover on their own, go prone under fire, get suppressed and break morally. A suppressed squad will not carry out an order — you have to pull it out and let it recover.

 The terrain works. Trees, bushes, walls, smoke and folds in the ground cut visibility. The canopy is treated as a separate layer: shelling strips the foliage, and a treeline whose forest has been shot away stops providing cover.

 Fortification. Trenches get dug, dugouts get built, communication trenches connect positions. All of it wears down under fire and collapses.

 Building assaults. You don't have to spend valuable infantry on a pointless assault of a fortified building — it's enough to blow the wall apart with a tank and enter through the breach you've made.

 The Drone War
 FPV . Drone mechanics are among the most important in the game, and we managed to build them so that they don't cause discomfort when playing the technical side, while being just as effective as in reality.

 Recon drones . The same kind of UAV as FPV, differing only in field of view; carries no armament

 EW and signal. Every operator has their own frequency on which they launch the drone, and EW systems have their own operating frequencies — they may not...

store.name: Tidy Farm
store.short: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.
store.about:
Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

 Was That A Tornado? 
 The farm is a complete disaster. Vegetables and fruits are scattered across the fields, tools are lying everywhere, flowers are piled up, eggs are rolling around, and even the chickens are running freely...
 Your job is simple:  Pick it up. Find where it belongs. Put it back. 

 Start with complete chaos and work your way towards a beautifully organized farm, one item at a time.

 Unlock Helpful Upgrades 
 As you tidy up the farm, you'll earn money that can be spent on upgrades designed to make every trip more efficient.

 Carry more items at once

 Move around the farm faster

 Get your dog to lend a paw

 Use a wheelbarrow to haul much more at once

 And more...

 Become faster, more efficient, and better equipped to take on the farm's mess.

 A Cozy, Satisfying Experience 
 There are no timers, no deadlines, and no pressure .
 Take your time, pick up a few items or tackle an enormous pile, it's completely up to you.

 Enjoy the simple satisfaction of cleaning, sorting, organizing, and watching your farm slowly become the cozy homestead you've always wanted.

 Features 
 Organize 4,544 items 

 Sort vegetables, fruits, flowers, tools, eggs, chickens and more

 Recruit your dog to help around the farm

 Use a wheelbarrow to move large amounts of items

 Earn money by cleaning up and spend it on helpful upgrades

 Upgrade your carrying capacity and movement speed and more

...

store.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
store.short: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!
store.about:
18,490 Bricks. One Small Town to Put Back Together.
 A little town is waiting to be put back together. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks in a relaxing first-person tidy-up game, solo or in online co-op with up to 5 players. Turn scattered pieces into buildings, and watch your work bring the town to life.

 COLLECT, SORT, AND BUILD
 Find the bricks you need by their shape and color. Follow each building’s plan and place the pieces in the right spots. Watch the piles get smaller as the walls grow taller.

 UNLOCK ABILITIES
 Unlock helpful abilities to make the work easier. Use a magnet to collect bricks, a wheelbarrow to carry them, and scaffolding to reach higher places. Spend less time carrying and more time building.

 WATCH THE TOWN CHANGE
 Turn piles of bricks into a cozy little town. Walk through the streets and enjoy the buildings you’ve finished. With every building you complete, there’s more to see.
 One brick at a time. Better together.

store.name: Defilade
store.short: Defilade is an old-school isometric RTS set in modern warfare. Command intelligent troops that take cover, rescue wounded comrades, dive from grenades, vault obstacles and dig trenches. Build your base, secure supply lines and fight across fully destructible massive battlefields that feel alive.
store.about:
I first discovered Red Alert back in the mid 90's and was instantly hooked, so many RTS games consumed me but after all these years, Red Alert, Sudden Strike 2 and Company of Heroes stuck with me, but it missed one crucial thing I kept yearning for... that was proper cover mechanics and better soldier AI logic. 

 So Defilade came along... the Idea started in early 2022, with prototyping, and 2026 was the year this idea came to its full form. 
 SOLDIERS
 The soldiers think a lot and i mean a lot! Almost every single object, vehicle even trees standing or blown off, gets used as cover. They heal, plan rescues, deep trench warfare, garrison buildings and medic teams even use stretchers to pick wounded up from the battlefield. When one of the medics gets killed the other medic will put down he's stretcher and drag the soldier. 

 PRISONER SYTEM
 Soldiers can surrender and when they do they get interrogated, and they can spill live intel on you or the enemy.  
 THE SMALL DETAILS
 Soldiers through grenades back
They will dive right before a FPV drone strike
Soldiers will try a rope rescue if a normal rescue failed.
They even take cover behind trees
They vault over low cover. 
They have realistic rag doll physics

store.name: Eiroku: Path of the Wanderer
store.short: Live the Sengoku era. Roam Japan, raise a warband, befriend warlords, and topple daimyo clans in battle. Rise from ronin to retainer, or raise your own banner and reach for the realm. A Sengoku sim of warband management, real-time battles, and living characters.
store.about:
Eiroku: Path of the Wanderer is a Sengoku-era simulation game set in feudal Japan.
 Travel freely across the map of Japan at the head of your warband. Hire soldiers in castle towns, meet merchants and bandits on the highways, hold council with castle lords, and at times strike down an enemy general with the ninja arts. Where you go and whom you serve is entirely up to you.
 ■ Two protagonists 
 Kagezakura the kunoichi takes the field herself and strikes down enemy generals.

 Ryuzaemon the merchant never takes the field; his men fight for him. He opens shops and gathers guild seats in the towns, aiming to become the realm's Merchant Prince.

 ■ A living map of Japan 
 A map of Japan rendered in the style of traditional ink-wash painting. Twenty-three daimyo clans and 195 locations—including castles, towns, farming villages, ninja hamlets, and shrines—come to life on this single map, complete with shifting seasons and times of day.

 Clans march, besiege, intercept, and negotiate on their own, and the map keeps changing.

 ■ Raise a warband, command the battle 
 What you can recruit depends on where you are: ashigaru in villages, samurai in towns, mounted samurai and horse archers at castles, warrior monks at shrines, and shinobi at ninja villages.

 Troops who survive battle gain experience and are promoted along branching lines: ashigaru into archers, then into arquebusiers or horse archers; spear cavalry into the elite Red Guard or White Guard; genin into chunin and jonin.

 Every soldier costs daily wages and provisions. A large army is strong, but it eats your purse...

store.name: Groundwork Simulator
store.short: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.
store.about:
WELCOME TO GROUNDWORK SIMULATOR 
 Groundwork Simulator puts you behind the controls of heavy machinery, with a landscape to reshape and gold to uncover. Dig into the hillside, haul material across your site and set up the equipment that turns a bucket of dirt into your next gold recovery. Work at your own pace or share the job with friends.

 EVERY BUCKET CHANGES THE LANDSCAPE
 Dig trenches, cut into hillsides and build up piles as you shape your worksite. Every scoop changes the ground you work on, creating new routes, steeper slopes and fresh challenges. Plan your approach, the ground you leave behind becomes the foundation for your next job.

 REALISTIC PHYSICS
 Dig with a realistic excavation engine and simulated hydraulic feedback that brings resistance to every scoop. Feel your machine respond as the bucket meets the ground and material builds up inside it. Adjust your angle and work with the available hydraulic power to cut through the terrain, fill your bucket and lift the load.

 FROM DIRT TO GOLD
 Explore the land in search of gold-rich ground. Drill and test for deposits, choose your digging spot and set up your wash plant. Excavate promising material, wash it through the sluice boxes and process the concentrate on the shaking table, from your first test hole to your next gold recovery.

 WORK SOLO OR SHARE THE SITE
 Run the operation yourself or divide the work in online co-op. Take the excavator while a friend handles transport, or keep material moving together between the digging area and the wash plant. Coordinate your machines and turn a patch of untouched...

store.name: Figure Me Out
store.short: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.
store.about:
A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.
 Read it. Type it. Eliminate. 

 Get a clear look at an opponent’s forehead and type their number to take them out. Keep moving, watch who’s looking your way, and try to remember those digits when the pressure hits.
 Make yourself harder to read 

 Blind opponents with flashbangs, block their view with smoke grenades, and draw their attention away with distract grenades. Use your items to create an opening when getting a good look is easier said than done.
 Get a better look 

 Use binoculars to read numbers and eliminate distant targets, or snap a photo with your camera that stays visible for a few seconds. Sometimes, an extra moment to read those digits is all you need.
 Capture flags. Rack up eliminations. 

 Fight for yourself in Deathmatch, join forces in Team Deathmatch, or push for the enemy flag in Capture the Flag. Every mode gives you a different reason to get close... and a very good reason to watch your forehead.
 Bring your friends. Meet your next targets. 

 Play with friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players. Face off against your group or team up against the opposition. You might trust your friends, but you probably shouldn’t let them read your number.

store.name: Moon Sweepers
store.short: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.
store.about:
The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush.

 Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time.

 Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter.

 Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries.

 Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows.

 Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

store.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
store.short: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.
store.about:
The lab is a mess. Time to fix it! 
Equipment is buried under piles of junk, test tubes are unlabeled, and the lab animals have escaped and are running loose.
 Quarantine Lab Sort is a first-person game about sorting items and restoring order. Clear out huge piles of clutter, find the right place for every item, and watch as the messy laboratory gradually transforms. From Chaos to Order 
Microscopes, medicine, books, Petri dishes, sample jars — around 250 types of items are waiting to be put in their proper place. You won't find 500 identical objects here: as you clear the clutter, you'll discover all kinds of laboratory equipment, samples, and other items. Arrange equipment on shelves, return samples to the appropriate storage containers, and throw away the trash.
 What's Inside the Test Tube? 
The lab contains 24 types of unknown samples. Place a test tube in the centrifuge and start an analysis to discover what's inside. You only need to examine one sample of each type — after that, you'll be able to identify every test tube of that kind.
 Catch Them First! 
The escaped animals won't patiently wait for you to carry them back to their cages. Chase them through the laboratory clutter or use an ability to stop the runaways for a few seconds.
Catch every animal and return it to its cage — they won't escape from there again.
 Warning: Radiation! 
Radioactive waste requires special handling. While you're holding it, your radiation meter gradually fills up. If you don't reach the disposal container in time, you'll have to drop your entire radioactive load.
Plan your route,...

store.name: MemeticBox
store.short: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.
store.about:
MemeticBox is a physics-driven voxel gore sandbox. Every character is built from thousands of voxels with skin, muscle, bone and organs underneath. Every shot, blade and explosion tears through them layer by layer. Play it as a tactical shooter, survive endless waves, or become a god and do whatever you want with them.
 ▎EVERY BODY IS MADE OF VOXELS
 Bullets carve real holes. Blades slice limbs clean off. Explosions rip bodies apart block by block. Under the skin there is muscle, bone, brain, lungs and heart, and everything you hit bleeds, breaks and falls where it should.
 - Headshots crack skulls open. Shotguns take heads clean off.
 - Wounded enemies stagger, crawl, clutch their wounds and writhe in agony.
 - Zombies without legs keep dragging themselves toward you.
 - Blood pools, runs across the floor, stains walls, tints water and even splatters your screen.
 ▎GOD MODE
 - Grab people and hurl them into walls. Stretch them until their arms rip off.
 - Hang them, nail them to walls, strike them with lightning and watch them convulse.
 - Build death traps: spike beds, spinning saws, grinders, mines.
 - Rain people from the sky. Start a war between Police and terrorists. Drive a whole crowd into a murderous rage.
 - Unleash tornadoes, earthquakes, meteor showers, blood rain and black holes that suck everyone into one screaming ball of flesh.
 - Film it all with a cinematic camera.
 ▎MODES
 - Police Raid, Bank Heist, Drug Lab: pick your loadout, give orders to your AI squad, breach doors, throw flashbangs, rescue hostages and arrest or eliminate the enemy.
 - Wave...

store.name: Left! Left! LEFT!
store.short: 2-player asymmetrical co-op rally chaos. One drives a sloppy hatchback with almost no HUD; the other navigates from a physical tablet. Call the turns, clear the mud, survive the cabin — and pray they hear “LEFT!” in time.
store.about:
Left! Left! LEFT! is a 2-player asymmetrical co-op rally chaos game.
 One drives a highly unstable hatchback with almost no HUD and zero map. The other sits with a physical tablet — GTA-style road minimap, cabin physics, and a voice that has to cut through panic.
 There are no AI enemies. The track is narrow. The car is sloppy. The cabin fights back.

 Drive blind. Navigate loud. Survive the cabin. 
 KEY FEATURES 
 Asymmetrical co-op — Driver vs. the road; Navigator vs. the cabin

 Physical tablet navigation — grab it, hold it, drop it, lose it mid-corner

 Cabin chaos — mud on the glass, dash knob wipe, doors that won't stay shut

 Arcade wreck physics — readable, messy hatchback feel (not a sim)

 Built for online duos who talk over each other

 One car. One navigator. Zero excuses when you miss the turn.
